articleTitle: Studies on the Application of Rough Set Analysis in Mining of Association Rules and the Realization in Provincial Road Transportation Management Information System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Application of rough set analysis in mining of association rule can predigest the operation of traditional mining association rules, and avoid redundant rules effectively. This paper presented the theory, question and resolution of application of rough set in mining association rules. And it presented resolve the relation of support, confidence and the amount of rules by rough set analysis originally. All the conclusion were proved in data mining in provincial road transportation management information System.

articleTitle: Fault Prediction of Power Supply Using SVR Optimized with QPSO
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, fault prediction approach on power supply mixture in the system of certain guidance radar is analyzed and a fault prediction method to optimize SVR based on QPSO is proposed. The QPSO algorithm is introduced, effect factors of SVR capability are analyzed and the steps to optimize SVR parameters based on QPSO are proposed. Experimental results of the fault prediction on power supply mixture show that this approach achieves low percent of error and has achieved the expected results.

articleTitle: Research on Vehicle Detection Method Based on Video Image
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Nowadays, there are quite a few methods that have their respective advantages and disadvantages to update the background, such as method of multiframes average, method of Gaussian distribution models etc. Considering those disadvantages above, the background updating algorithm which be advanced in the research can reduce the effect by shadow effectively by doing the calculation of H chrominance component on HSI space, achieving a lasting update automatically by operating the frequency statistics after every sampling. Applying the method of combining edge detection of morphologic and difference of background together to the target detection, a method of foreground area extraction based on the edge information has been brought forward in this research. The method of morphologic edge detection algorithm has a good restrain on noises while doing the edge detection. Therefore, in vehicle detection, the background difference will be done after respective morphologic edge detection of the current video image and background image. Use the extraction template of background edge to extract the precise background edge of the current frame, then a foreground edge of the vehicle will be extracted, finally use the mathematical morphology to do the later treatment to the result of target dividing, remove the noise. The experiment has proved that the measure mentioned above has increased the accuracy and stability of vehicle detection effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Camouflage Characteristics of Color Vision
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Human beings depend on vision to accept the outside information. The color plays an important role in the vision. In the process of design digital camouflage, it is important to know about color characteristic from the angles on physics, physiology and psychology. The paper analyzes the fundamental characteristics of digital camouflages from the points of view on the theories on color, It designs a mixed-color experiment for testing the different effect in the case of different distance. The result gives an important reference for design the camouflage.

articleTitle: An Optimization Method Based on Vague Set Selection in Architectural Engineering
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a similarity measurement formula based on Vague Set is proposed, and is used in selecting the evaluation index system, establishing the preferred vague sets. The candidate data sets in a interval is abstracted into low dimension values. Then, the optimized solution sets is calculated through obtaining the vague similarity measurements between candidate vague sets and the ideal optimal vague set. The similarity measurements between vague set is the core of such application. The simulation results reveal that using the vague optimal method in soft base selection is promising.

articleTitle: Determination Method of Piecewise Linear Membership Function Based on the Interval Density Cluster
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Triangle and monotone membership functions have simple forms and clear physical meaning, which are commonly used in the research work. In this paper, a density clustering method based on the interval is brought forward, which has avoided the cluster results falling into a local minimum, also by using this method, the cluster center can be quickly obtained. Through simulation, the piecewise linear membership function of variation of total volume in petroleum drilling is determined, which solves the problem that the function is hard to be defined.

articleTitle: Acquisition Digital Baseband Module for Multichannel GPS Receiver
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a model based design technique for implementing acquisition module in the GPS receiver, by using FFT based code phase search acquisition algorithm. This is used to find out from which satellite the signal is coming to the GPS receiver. SFF-SDR Lyrtech board has been used to implement this module. The results, after further processing by tracking module, give the code phase and the carrier frequency of the signal.

articleTitle: The Globally Exponentially Stability of Switched Impulsive Systems with Mixed Delays
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the exponential stability of a class of switched impulsive systems with mixed delays. Based on some impulsive delay differential inequalities, a sufficient condition for globally exponential stability of switched impulsive systems with mixed time delays is estabilished.

articleTitle: The License Plate Image Binarization Based on Otsu Algorithm and MATLAB Realize
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This article is about the technology of using Otsu algorithm to binary the license plate image. Meanwhile, the author presents the theory of Otsu algorithm, and the theories of binarization method to deal with gray-scale image of the license plate. Then the results of the license plate image binarization based on MATLAB are presented.

articleTitle: Research on Routing Algorithm for Wireless Sensor Network Based on Energy Balance
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper further analyzes the energy consumption model of the LEACH protocol, and proposes a routing algorithm for wireless sensor networks based on energy balance. It uses a more reasonable clustering method; thereby it can further balance energy consumption of the network. In this algorithm the cluster head periodically compute the residual energy of all of members in each work cycle. It takes into full account the residual energy of nodes to determine the route. It chooses an appropriate route under the premise that transmission efficiency and network energy consumption are balanced. Simulation experiments results show that the routing algorithm based on energy balance proposed by this paper can balance the relationship of routing and energy consumption, and can prolong the network lifetime.

articleTitle: Research on Validity of EDFA Gain Competition Attack in Optical Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Security problems of optical networks are very serious now. One of convenient and effective attack methods is the use of EDFA gain competition effect. This paper researches on realization principles of gain competition based on two deficiencies of EDFA. The validity of EDFA gain competition attack is proved by simulation and experiment. The result indicates that the attack method is implemented easily, the effect is evidence, and the operation is favorable.

articleTitle: A Vague Decision Method and its Application in Choosing Tailings Dam Locations
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Proposing the new formular of measuring similarity of Vague sets, deducting the filter factor indicators; extracting options; establishing the best program; constructing the Vague environment; converting the raw data into Vague Data, obtaining the Vague sets of each options and the best option Vague set; computing the similarity measure and Vague Decision, calculating the similarity measure between the options of Vague sets and the best option of the Vague sets; by the value of similarity measure the Vague Decision is achieved: the maximum value of similarity measure corresponds to the optimal solution.

articleTitle: A Signal Denoise Algorithm Based on Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose an algorithm for removing Gaussian noise from signal while preserving important details for further processing. The algorithm is based on wavelet modulus maximum theory. A wavelet transform modulus maximum algorithm for signal denoising was presented and analyzed deeply. The simulation results show that the method is effective in both noise removing and detail preserving.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Method on Choosing Equipment Procurement Project Organization Structure
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Building institution of equipment procurement project management is an important goal of the equipment procurement institution revolutionary and choosing the right organizational structure is primary issue to achieve the goal. Based on the characteristics of the project, the paper builds the choosing model of equipment procurement project organization structure, and designs a quantitative method. Through the application example, the validity of the choosing method is proved.

articleTitle: Combining Co-Training and Co-Testing for Interactive Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper presents an elastic framework with human interactions for image segmentation. Under this framework, we extract color and texture features for each pixel and consider them as two independent views. Based on pixel classification, the image segmentation can be accomplished through combining multi-view semi-supervised and active learning with human interactions. Experiments on various color images show the feasibility and effectiveness of our framework.

articleTitle: Study of Non-intrusion Optical Fiber Fluid Flow Monitoring System Using Flow-induced Pipe Vibration
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In the oil field development and production, fluid flow is an extremely important parameter which determines the transmission characteristics of the oil production, real-time monitoring of fluid flow parameter provides a scientific basis for oil and gas optimization exploration and increase of reservoir recovery. A method for interrogating fiber optic sensors non-intrusively sensing fluid flow using flow-induced pipe vibration is proposed, the study is conducted on vibration induced by turbulent flow when fluid flow through pipe. The fixed relationship between standard deviation of pipe wall's vibration induced by fully developed turbulence and mean flow rate was determined.

articleTitle: Control Study in IPM based Switched Reluctance Motor System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a IPM based SRD system, which achieves some advantages: such as safety reliability and simple design. It focus on the analysis of varies operation modes of single IPM based SRD system, studying the intention of design process in detail: including freewheeling procession, transferring, and operating states of clockwise and anticlockwise rotation condition, it offers reference for designer to select devices of the main circuit and decrease the project exploiting time. The theoretical analysis is verified by experimental results.

articleTitle: A Hybrid System Dynamic Production Scheduling Method Based on Multi-Agent
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: To solve the dynamic and complex problem of production scheduling, depending on the introduction between multi-agent and hybrid genetic algorithm in hybrid system production scheduling, this paper proposed a hybrid system production scheduling method based on multi-agent. In this method, the logic framework and cooperation mechanism of hybrid system dynamic production scheduling and were established. Finally, a simulation system of hybrid system dynamic production scheduling based on multi-agent was demonstrated and validated by QUEST software. It has shown the proposed method can improve the benefit of production scheduling, and provide a support for adapting to complex and dynamic production scheduling in hybrid system production.

articleTitle: Investigation of Thrust Reverser Cascade Design Using Aerodynamic and Structural Integration
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Through the prediction of aerodynamic and structural performance of the cascade thrust reverser, aerodynamic and structural integration design improved the layout of cascade vanes and reduced the design costs and operational costs. Using computational fluid dynamics (CFD) technology, integrated design approach could simulate the flow field of the cascade thrust reverser, and complete the evaluation of the aerodynamic performance of the thrust reverser. Using finite element analysis (FEA) method, the vanes by the force were analyzed and the numerical simulation of the thrust reverser structure and properties were completed. In this study, the effects of different number of cascade channels and number of vanes on the aerodynamic and structural performances were investigated. The results indicated that reducing the number of cascade channels would cause a decline in the reverser efficiency, but we could get the benefit of reducing the number of vanes. Reducing the number of transverse supports improved the reverser efficiency and reduced the weight of thrust reverser, but it also increased the maximum stress and deformation of vanes.

articleTitle: Optical Design of a Line Scanning Laser Ophthalmoscope
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The paper describes the optical design of a line scanning laser ophthalmoscope (LSO). A line beam is used to illuminate the retina, meanwhile a linear array sensor is used for imaging the retina. For the Liou & Brennan eye model, we set the pupil diameter to be 2 mm, and the field of view is 6 degree on retinal plane (about 1.8 mm X 1.8 mm). ZEMAX optical modeling analysis shows that the main optical system achieves diffraction limit through the entire scanning angle. The magnification of the optical system is about 7 times, and the transverse resolution is less than 10 µm. For our 512 X 512 pixels imaging mode (the sensor line frequency is 98 KHZ), the frame frequency can achieve 200 fps.

articleTitle: Gathering Correlated Data in Wireless Sensor Networks Using a Heuristic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: We propose a routing scheme for data gathering and aggregation in wireless sensor networks. The scheme aims to optimise an aggregation tree in order to minimise the energy dissipation of data aggregation and transmission. A modified particle swarm optimisation algorithm is developed in the proposed scheme. In addition, the routing scheme uses a generic data aggregation model which accommodates different correlation conditions. The performance of the proposed scheme is evaluated and compared with three other existing data gathering algorithms. Simulation results show that the proposed scheme outperforms existing algorithms in terms of energy consumption and that the scheme can adapt to the change of network connectivity and data correlation conditions.

articleTitle: Optimizing Method for Synchronization of Small-World Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A novel optimizing technique for small-world network model is proposed and demonstrated. The effects of the key parameters to the synchronization of complex networks are investigated theoretically, including the characteristic path length, distribution degree, clustering coefficient and betweenness. It is found that the networks present a significant synchronization different with the equal characteristic path length and clustering coefficient. Simulation results show that neither the characteristic path length nor the clustering coefficient of complex networks can independently demonstrate the synchronization of the complex network. The heterogeneity of the distribution degree essentially suppresses the synchronization of complex networks, while the maximal betweenness is an effective indicator for synchronizability.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation on Efficient Display Algorithm of Embedded GIS Map
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Embedded GIS map display technology based on QR-tree spatial index algorithm is described combining the characteristics of embedded technology and GIS technology. The shortage of QR-tree algorithm is analyzed and improved algorithm is put forward in paper. The method of space index to improve data retrieval speed is proposed using the improved QR-tree. Rapid display of embedded GIS system map in Windows mobile 6 simulator is realized and the simulation result shows the algorithm is effective.

articleTitle: Research on Intensity Noise Suppression for Closed Loop FOG
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The main factor of random walk in a high precision fiber optic gyroscope is the intensity noise using erbium-doped fiber source, so decrease the intensity noise can reduce random walk. An intensity noise suppression method is proposed to reduce the random walk. An approach to reduce the random walk using subtraction combined with depolarizer was advanced after analyzing the relation of light intensity, phase and degree of polarization between two light beams. Analyze the gyroscope output data with Allan variance and we could determine from the result that the random walk coefficient was reduced by 32% than before.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Repair on Bituminous Pavement Main Distresses of Expressway
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the traffic load heavy, traffic flow channel, traffic density increases trends, many expressway performances have been gradually began to decay, such as road distresses, carrying capacity, anti-slide sharply worsen. Expressway cannot provide for vehicles, safe, comfortable, fast operation environment. Therefore, timely to expressway maintenance and repair, make its use to recover and improve the performance, extend the use fixed number of year, this way not only for expressway management department provides the huge economic efficiency, but also for the convenience of travel, expressway users to promote social material circulation is ensured. The main distresses of bituminous pavement are analyzed, such as crack, pot hole, bleeding and so on.

articleTitle: Improving TLS Protocol Using Identity-Based Double-certificate Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Although Identity-Based Cryptography (IBC) has many attractive properties, its application is restricted for lacking of security protocols supporting. To overcome this problem, we propose an improved Transport Layer Security (TLS) protocol using identity-based double-certificate mechanism (IBDC_TLS) in this paper. Firstly, the concept of identity-based double-certificate is presented. Secondly, by designing new cipher suites, IBC is appended to security parameters. At last, by modifying protocol message parameters, the TLS protocol is improved to fit the double-certificate mechanism. The results show that IBDC_TLS has advantages of lightweight and efficiency of IBC and flexibility of key recovery and management of double-certificate mechanism, as well as easy to deploy.

articleTitle: Area-Layered Paths Optimizing Algorithms of Platoon Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper combined with the actual task, gives the basic definitions to the vehicle platoon, put forward the vehicle platoon regional layered path optimization algorithm. Through example illustrated, the results show the algorithm is stable and feasible, accord with the actual demand situation.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis of CAC Schemes Based on Multi-level GSM-R Services
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper focuses on safety, reliability requirements and the needs of multi-service in railway communication and carries out researches combined with theory illustration and simulation analysis. Available resources of railway are scarce currently, while services facing to the railway communication are various, such as the radio dispatch services, train control services, as a result, the resources of system are severely limited. At the same time, there are many different services and service-level requirements, such as train control services with high reliability requirements, train radio dispatch services demanding real-time feature, the data services in general level. Therefore, it is essential to take appropriate resource allocation strategies. A dynamic adaptive resource call admission strategy is presented in this paper. Network performance is also compared through simulations under a variety of call admission strategies. In conclusion, wireless network resources are fully and effectively used in condition of ensuring the QoS (Quality of Service).

Author Keywords: GSM-R (Global System of Mobile for Railways)

articleTitle: Research on Image Information Hiding Method Based on (T,N) Threshold
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The image information hiding method based on (T, N) threshold hides a smaller image file or other special hidden digital files into the n images which are larger ones. It achieves the purpose of information hiding using the image information redundancy of human. We must get more than T carrier images at least which have loaded the information of the hidden image if we want to restore the information. The T is the threshold. The image information hiding method based on (T, N) threshold has a greater enhancement than traditional method in fault tolerance and safety. In this paper, the concept of pixel item which contains T bytes or T pixels has been proposed. Pixel item is used as the basic unit of information processing, and reduces the computational greatly.

articleTitle: The Game Theory Research for Human-Computer and Human-Human
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Game theory provides a solution to the problem of finding a set of optimal decision-making strategies in a group. However, people seldom play such optimal strategies and adjust their strategies based on their experience. In this paper, the game theory research of human-computer and human- human were investigated, and the ultimatum game was used in the experiment. The game theory of human-computer random, human- computer intelligent, human-computer (human) and human-human were investigated in detail. We found that the ERPs of proposer were significantly more negative on trials when decision maker chose the disagreement project compared with ERPs of proposer when decision maker chose the agreement project, there is obvious FRN at about 250ms.

articleTitle: Real-time Measurement of Retardation of a Quarter-wave Plate Using Wollaston Prism
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Real-time measurement of the retardation of the quarter-wave plate (QWP) using a Wollaston prism is presented. The collimated beam passes through a circular polarizer, the quarter-wave plate to be measured, a standard quarter-wave plate and then is split by a Wollaston prism. Two sub-beams are detected by a bi-cell detector. From two detection signals, the retardation of the QWP is obtained in real time and is independent of the fast axis azimuth of QWP. At the same time, the method is easy to expand to measure the retardation of the QWP used in deep ultraviolet band and the retardation distribution of the QWP. In experiments, the average and the standard deviation of the retardation of quarter-wave plate are respectively 89.5° and 0.25°. The usefulness of the method is verified.

articleTitle: Enhancement and Evaluation of the Image Edge Ringing Artifact Based on the Human Visual System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The edge ringing artifacts often appears near image edge after deconvolution. We presented an iterative enhancement algorithm to remove the edge ringing artifact. We also presented an edge ringing metric to evaluate the quality of images enhanced based on the human visual system. The metric is used to assessment the edge ringing artifact based on the analysis of the structure of it. The experimental results validate the proposed enhancement and evaluation methods perform well.

articleTitle: Shaping Bayesian Network Based Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The trial-and-error mechanism of reinforcement learning essentially is a kind of exhaustive search, which is also the major reason to cause reinforcement learning being slow and time-consuming. We present an approach to model the state transitions in agent's exploration by Shaping Bayesian Network, which can be used to shape agent for bias exploration towards the most promising regions of state space and thereby reduce exploration and accelerate learning. The experiment results show this approach can significantly improve agent's performance and shorten learning time. More importantly, this approach provides a kind of way to make agent can take advantage of its own experience to accelerate learning.

articleTitle: Continuous-wave and Passively Q-switched c-cut Nd:CaYAlO4 Laser at 1.08 µm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: We demonstrated an efficient high-power continuous-wave (cw) and passively Q-switched disordered c-cut Nd:CaYAlO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> laser at 1.08 um. Continuous-wave output power of 3.26 W was obtained with an optical conversion efficiency of 25.9% and a slope efficiency of 28.5%. In the passive Q-switching operation, the highest average output power, the shortest pulse width, largest pulse energy and highest peak power were achieved to be 2.61 W, 11.37 ns, 45.5 μJ and 2.43 kW, respectively, with Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG crystal as the saturable absorber.

articleTitle: The Design of JPOR-32 Controller
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: JPOR-32 is a 32-bit processor that can directly execute Java bytecodes and provide effective support for real-time performance. By analyzing the flow of Java instructions in the data path of JPOR-32, we design the controller for various operations. This controller realizes the conversion from standard Java bytecodes to JPOR RISC instructions through micro-code technique. Thus, it would be easy to add instructions needed for specific applications, which makes the processor reconfigurable. Simulation results take the execution of an instruction as an example to show the correctness of this controller during execution.

articleTitle: River System Extraction Based on BP Neural Network and DEM Data
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Extracting river system is the main content of remote sensing hydrological analysis. This paper studies a method of extracting river system based on Back Propagation (BP) neural network and DEM data. The study region is the northwest area of Liangzhu, in Yuhang district Zhejiang province. To simplify the BP network structure, principal component analysis technique is used according to the spectral characteristics of TM image. In addition, slope data derived from DEM is also used as an input layer of BP network. At the same time, the traditional band ratio method is applied to do comparative study. By comparing the two methods, and found: band ratio method can inhibit the vegetation information, but poor accuracy, and the method in this paper can distinguish some noise and water, obtained a more satisfactory results.

articleTitle: The Research of Optimizing Page Ranking Based on User's Feature
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In order to get a better user experience, to create user features based on user behavior, optimize and improve feature selection process, so as to achieve a selection process with the combination of user preferences, the search results will be better reflect the user's preferences. This paper proposes an algorithm of establish the feature of the document and the user feature at the same time, these features will be add into the sorting process, as to achieve better user experience.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electricity Prices Volatility Based on Multicycle GARCH-M Model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The volatility of electricity price is the important information for the risk management of power markets and the pricing of power financial derivatives. A GARCH-M model in which the multi-cycle properties of electricity price series are described by dummy variable and sine function is proposed. The model is easy to select the order, and holds parsimonious scale of estimated parameters and high practical application value. The numerical example based on the historical data of the PJM market shows that the hetero-scedasticity and the load squares have a significant effect on the mean electricity price, and there exists volatility clustering.

articleTitle: Portable Rock Bolts Nondestructive Testing System Design Based on ARM and Windows CE
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A type of portable rock bolt nondestructive detecting system is designed, which is based on the ARM and Windows CE operating system. In hardware design, the signal acquisition module, A/D conversion module, LCD module and the power module are introduced respectively. In software design, the Windows CE operating system customization and the design applications program are completed. Proved by the experiment, the system has a good application prospect in paractical application.

articleTitle: A Study of Rural Information and Service Sharing Platform Based on Cloud Computing Technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Survey of rural residents, according to information acquisition status of rural information resource status and service, and puts forward the problem of low efficiency based on cloud computing information sharing platform design ideas and solutions.

articleTitle: Shrinking Projection Methods for Quasi-Strict Asymptotically Pseudo-Contractions
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this article is to propose a shrinking projection method and prove a strong convergence theorem for a family of quasi-strict asymptotically pseudo-contractions. Its results hold in reflexive, strictly convex, smooth Banach spaces with the property(K). The results of this paper improve and extend recent some relative results.

articleTitle: The Power Analysis Research of Engine Electronic Control Unit
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This article through linear stabilized voltage supply compared with a switching stabilized voltage supply, switching stabilized voltage supply has obtained high efficiency, voltage stability, low energy consumption advantages. The switching stabilized voltage supply supply more suitable power supply provided solutions as automotive engine electronic control unit.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis of the Eigenvector in the Non-Conservative System with Repeated Eigenvalues
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A modal method for computing sensitivities of the eigenvectors of a non-conservative system with repeated eigenvalues by using matrix analysis in the presence of a first-order system is proposed. The characteristic matrixes of system are not limited by the restrictions of symmetric and positive definiteness. And it successfully avoids the effects of multiple eigenvalues. The simplicity and economy have been now established during the reasoning and implementing processes. A numerical example is presented to demonstrate the efficiency and correctness of the modal method proposed.

articleTitle: Exploration of Finance and Economic College Computer Undergraduate Curriculum System Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: According to college computer curriculum system routine, lack of features, on the basis of analyzing the computer training mode of Finance and Economic College, this paper presents setting principles of computer curriculum in Finance and Economic College, combined with our practical, protruding the characteristics of cross discipline, developed a plan for the setting of computer curriculum system in Finance and Economic college, cultivating can use economics knowledge, modern scientific method and computer technology in comprehensive economic analysis and computer programming to compound and applied talents.

articleTitle: Multi-core-based Tree Routing Protocol for Hip-multicast Model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A new multi-core-based tree routing protocol for HIP-multicast model is proposed, which includes the process of data transmission, message format, structure of routing table and dynamically update algorithm. The theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the new protocol is suitable for HIP-multicast model, and has low complexity, good scalability and high efficiency.

articleTitle: A Revised Adaptive Method to Reduce Synchronization Time and Improve Synchronizability
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Considering the heterogeneity of degree distribution in scale-free networks, we propose a revised adaptive method where the dynamic change of coupling strength is determined by not only the local states difference between the connected node and its neighbors, but also the degree of this node. By this method, the synchronization time of scale free network is decreased and the synchronizability is enhanced compared with the adaptive method of Zhou and Kurths.

articleTitle: Design of Embedded Performance Testing and Fault Diagnosing Platform
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Once who has developed a complete high-performance embedded digital signal parallel processing platform, its performance testing and fault diagnosing is a task must be completed. For an advanced embedded parallel processing platform, we have built a performance test and fault diagnosis platform, the main interface of the client program send the test command to the server side by the network interface program, the server-side download the DSP or FPGA program to the board through the PCI-E driver program, and then read the test results, send the results back to the main interface program to complete the testing process. Performance test used to ensure the performance of the system running to meet user's demand, play an important role in quality assurance. Fault diagnosis is also required during the development stage.

articleTitle: Application of PARAFAC Method in Petroleum Pollutant Measurement and Identification
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The paper applies parallel factor analysis (PARAFAC) in petroleum pollutant measurement and identification. A series of 3-dimentional fluorescence spectrum are obtained by a FS920 fluorescence spectrometer, including the CCl4 solutions of a 97# gasoline sample and a 0# diesel oil sample, and the solutions which mixed by these two solutions in different proportions. The range of extraction wavelength is between 300nm to 400nm, and the range of emission wavelength is between 330nm to 500nm. The data of these 3-dimentional fluorescence spectra compose a 3-way data array. The paper overlooks the specific components of petroleum pollutant, and regards each of petroleum products as a whole, the PARAFAC could obtain satisfactory spectrum decomposition effect similarly, and the prediction of concentration of predicted set is satisfactory also.

articleTitle: Fiber Optical Oil Well Temperature and Pressure Monitoring System Based on Component Technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Temperature and pressure are two significant reasons directly affecting oil production rate. There are many oil well temperature and pressure monitoring system about this field. But these systems are usually developed for some specific customers. Under the circumstances, every system is different in system functions, demodulation devices and sensors, so they are lack of generality and waste a lot of resources. In this paper we apply the component technology to the development of fiber optical oil well temperature and pressure monitoring system. The requirements of changing demodulation devices, sensors or the data processing algorithm can be met through switching proper components. It can improve the efficiency of system development and strengthen the scalability and reusability of whole system.

articleTitle: Simulation and Study of Vehicle-Vehicle Device System Ride Performance
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Take a certain vehicle and vehicle devices system as studying object, build up its mechanical model and derive the mathematical model with LaGrange formula. Establish the four-wheel spectrum as system input, program to calculate suspension dynamic deflection RMS value and wheel relative dynamic load RMS value, plot the spectrum curve of each DOF, simulate the system response in frequency domain under random road stimulation.

articleTitle: Design of Control System of Manipulator of Thin-Wall Rotating Workpiece
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In actual application environment such as industry and architecture, usually there are some work pieces to carry and transfer. The manipulator control system designed in this paper consists of the single chip C8051F021 and the Programmable Logic Device (CPLD). The manipulator has the functions such as operating both automatically and manually, monitoring the voltage of the battery, alarming and so on. This paper mainly presented the structure and function of the manipulator and the control method of the circuit. And the motor control module and the battery voltage monitoring module are also described. Finally, the communication part and the software programming part of the system are presented. The experiment result shows that this control system reaches the expected purpose and can be widely applied to the industry field.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Dynamic Response of Viaduct Rail Transit
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Urban mass transit rail track vibration attenuation research becomes more and more important. Different type rail track vibration attenuation methods have to been research. According to current size of urban mass transit rail viaduct, two track dynamic finite element model, elastic fasteners system and floating slab, were built in Ansys software with rail viaduct finite element. In order to identify their capacity of attenuating wheel-rail impact, field test rail vertical force was applied on the rail element in the finite element, and dynamic responses of different places in the two rail track finite element are compared. The result certifies that the floating slab can attenuate low and medium frequency vibration component of viaduct distinctly, reducing noise produced by vibration of viaduct, and it is a better vibration attenuation method.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Dynamic Replication Strategy for the Data Grid
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The dynamic replication strategies for the Data Grid are discussed, which includes the intra-domain derivative strategy and the cross-domain expansion strategy. According to the strategies, a cross-domain expansion strategy of Cascading Replication plus Economic Model is described, which can evaluate the performances of the three different kind access patterns by using the three different replication strategies. The simulation results show that the replication strategy significantly reduces the average working time and improves the utilization of grid resources and validates the model's superiority.

articleTitle: An Improved Algorithm of Noise Elimination to Image Threshold
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Image noise often affects the clarity of the image, resulting in image blurring. In order to better remove the image noise, especially the rich details in the image to remove noise in the area, the traditional denoising method is usually difficult to complete. To solve this problem, in order to better remove the image noise, preserving image details. In the classical wavelet soft and hard threshold denoising method based on a wavelet packet analysis based on improved methods. Wavelet packet transform is a time-frequency analysis, frequency analysis is better than the wavelet transform will be applied to image noise cancellation. Mat lab simulation results show that this method overcomes the shortcomings of the traditional threshold method to effectively improve the image to remove noise, higher resolution, and its noise cancellation effect is better than the wavelet denoising method. Wavelet packet transformation is a method for analysis of relations between time and frequency.

articleTitle: Requirements Analysis for Vehicle-to-Vehicle Safety Communication
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Vehicle-to-vehicle safety communication has become an important means for improving driving safety. Vehicle-to vehicle safety communication requirements are studied systematically in this paper. The major safety applications are analyzed. Safety message and the corresponding communication requirement are designed. The safety communication performance metrics are proposed. Research of this paper could be used to guide designation of vehicle-to vehicle safety communication protocols.

articleTitle: Research and Realization of Recognition and Editing System for Software Installer
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the problem that Trojans and plug-ins bundled with the software installers bring the potential danger, this paper presents an installer reorganization model based on the feature detection and an editing model based on the file structure by analyzing the structural characteristic of software installer, and realizes the relative experimental system. Using the interaction of each module of system, it can achieve the detection and modification of most software installer. This experimental system covers 80% of the software installers, and has high accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Neural Network Optimized by Improved Genetic Algorithms to Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this study, diagnosis was performed with an evolutionary artificial neural network approach based on adaptive genetic algorithm with strong macro-search capability and global optimization, which was used to optimize initial weights and thresholds of the network. Simulation showed that the algorithm could be used for computer aided diagnosis after a large number of liver abscess cases had learned.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Web Services in an Expert System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: After have analysed the qualities of the web services and the insufficiency in the existing expert systems, This paper designed an assembling unit fault diagnosis expert system of a power station based on the web services architecture, and studied knowledge database management and inference mechanism in the diagnose system in detail.

articleTitle: Silicon Micro-machined Optical Microphone Based on Fizeau Interferometry and PGC Demodulation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Fiber-optic microphones have good features of anti-EMI and small size. They can be used in some places where conventional microphones would be hardly applied due to the flexibility of optical fiber. This paper presents theoretical calculations of silicon micro-machined fiber-optic microphone based on Phase-Generated-Carrier (PGC) demodulation, and also develops an experimental optical microphone system using Fizeau interferometer. Experimental results show that this microphone system has high voltage sensitivity, achieving to -12dB at the single frequency of 2 kHz and SNR at 102dB at the same time. The system is of higher precision than traditional capacitive microphone in specific frequency band.

articleTitle: One Practical Data Fusion Algorithm Applied in Auxiliary Particle Filtering
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The filtering for target tracking is discussed in the paper, in order to find a method with better accuracy and reliability than extended Kalman (EKF) filtering and unscented Kalman filtering(UKF), this paper built a non-linear system model - turn model, then a method of auxiliary particle filters combination with data fusion is proposed. Auxiliary particle filtering for character of the turn model modified every particle before resampling according to likelihood function, which can get the certain accuracy of filtering with fewest particles. In order to improve the filtering result further, it used multi-auxiliary particle filters with a practical data fusion algorithm that is efficient in turn model and can get good result through computer simulation.

articleTitle: Extracted Modal Parameters by Laplace Wavelet Correlation Filtering Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Two improved methods is proposed based on the Laplace wavelet correlation filtering method. They extend the scope of the original method, Improving the precision of modal parameter estimation.

articleTitle: Research on Anti-Laser-Eavesdropping Devices
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Research of anti-laser-eavesdropping devices is very critical to the security of confidential meetings for the nation and enterprises. Based on the depth study of laser eavesdropping principle as well as the human hearing characteristics, an implementation of anti-laser-eavesdropping was proposed. The system is composed of the noise generators and vibration transducers. Voice signals before and after eavesdropping were compared, the results of which show that the anti-laser-eavesdropping devices could produce noise signal which could mask the voice signal and successfully block the laser eavesdropping channels.

articleTitle: Simulation Software Applied in Electronic Technology Teaching
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Multisim is a commercially available computer based learning simulation software, that is often used as an educational tool for teaching electronics. This paper first introduces several simulation software's characteristic, then points out why chooses multisim to apply in electronic technology teaching. Besides, the author mainly shows that how to use multisim software to analyses the applied examples concretely and give the simulation figures, thus show good points of simulation software used in electronic technology teaching.

articleTitle: Study on the Routing Metric of Multi-channel Wireless Mesh Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Basic on the routing metric WCETT of Wireless Mesh Network, a new routing metric named WCETT-WR is proposed in this paper. It contains parameters about backoff time to wait for the channel and interference within and between paths. In order to strike a balance between various factors, two weighting parameters named and are also introduced into WCETT-WR. It can be known from the simulation results that the WCETT-WR metric can significantly improve the network performance.

articleTitle: TEM Response of a Large Loop Source over a Halfspace and a Layered Halfspace
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The all-time and late-time response of TEM over a homogeneous half space and layered half space are described. We analyzed the theoretical results and gave the differences between all-time resistivity and late-time resistivity. By using the program EMMA, the effects of three different models on TEM measurements are further discussed. Finally the advantages and disadvantages of three different models were obtained.

articleTitle: Determination of Flutter Boundary by Robust Flutter Margin Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A new method, robust flutter margin method, of determining flutter boundary was introduced. Leverages the structured singular value theory will flutter model combining organically flight test data, prediction of flutter boundary. Simulation results show that the method is feasible.

articleTitle: H8 Control for Uncertain Systems with Time-Varying Delay
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper is concerned with the design of H∞ controller for uncertain systems with time-varying delay. By constructing a Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional and introducing some free-weighting matrices, a delay-dependent bounded real lemma (BRL) is presented in terms of linear matrix inequalities (LMIs). Based on this BRL, an H∞ controller is designed to stabilize the system and preserve a prescribed H∞ performance level of the closed-loop system. Numerical examples are given to show the effectiveness and less conservatism of the proposed results.

articleTitle: An Initial Rate Estimation Algorithm for Distributed Video Coding
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: An Initial Rate Estimation(IRE) is proposed for pixel domain Wyner-Ziv video coding scheme. The approach is first based on the Lapacian correlation model to estimate the minimum rate chunks required for the Slepian-Wolf encoded data then the encoder adjust minimal rate chunks according to the characteristic of feedback channel and temporal correlation among bitplane, and the suitable initial rate chunks would be obtain to decoder the current bitplane. Experimental results shows that this algorithm greatly reduce decoding complexity without negatively impacting the rate-distortion performance and the encoding complexity.

articleTitle: The Enterprise Information System Based on Web Integrated Solutions
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the vigorous development of web technology, Enterprise information system has from the traditional closed, independent model into a more flexible open, cooperation model. Enterprise information system integration is also from pure procedure of integration, gradually transition between enterprise range and the different between applications across the enterprise integration. This paper discusses how to use XML based Web Service technology enterprise to realize the integration of information, make each systems work together smoothly, greatly improving enterprise benefit.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Coal Mine Hoist Electrical Control System Based on Fuzzy Rough Set
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on fuzzy rough set theory a novel fault diagnosis for the coal mine hoist electrical control system is proposed in the paper. The process of the mine hoist is introduced, and the working principle of the electronic control system is described. The fault types of the coal mine hoist are classified, and the fault sources of different kind of faults are analyzed. The different fault rules are established with fuzzy logical set theory. By rough set theory the fault features are abstracted and the fault rules are simplified. The primary research results show that the suggested method can find the characteristic parameters in the much fault information of the coal mine hoist electrical control system, and it is very helpful to deal with imprecise information of each system fault source signal, and to diagnose fault through the fuzzy rough set theory.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Watermarking Algorithm Using Wavelet Tree
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the information of original image, a quantization algorism of wavelet tree is proposed. The algorism can change the value of the root node of the wavelet tree to embed the watermarking information and combine the position information of the sub-node to correct the mistaken information. The common attacks such as median filtering, average filtering, and Gaussian noise can be resisted in the algorism. The experiment shows the algorism introduced in this paper has the strong adaptive ability, quick computation, good invisibility and robustness.

articleTitle: The Algorithm Research on the Strong Vertex-Distinguishing Total Coloring of Complete Graph

articleTitle: A Web Service Hierarchy Algorithm Based on QOS Similarity
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the development of SOA based on web services, there are more and more web services with same interface and similar function. How to find and choose the best web service is an important problem that all SOA enterprises face. QoS is used to describe the quality criteria of a web service. In this paper, a new algorithm of web service hierarchy base on QoS similarity has been proposed, which is concerned with meeting requirements of service consumers and the satisfaction with load requirement.

articleTitle: Optimization of Muffler of Engines by Computers and Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The low frequent noise of engine exhaust system is the main component of exhaust noise. Whether decreasing the noise of exhaust system or not has became a critical indicator of evaluating acoustic characteristics of mufflers. In order to reduce the noise of the engine exhaust system, this paper presents an improved muffler model, comparing the transmission loss of both the former muffler and the modified muffler. Then it establishes a coupled model with the engine and the muffler to analyze the noise of the engine exhaust system. Simulation results show that the performance of the modified muffler is superior to the former muffler.

articleTitle: Analysis of Material Science Problems in High-power LED Process
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This article explains the roles and material science problems of passivation layer, metal bonding, phosphor and Distributed Bragg Reflector in GaN-based LED device process, and introduces the methods and related processes to solve these problems from the view of material science.

articleTitle: Simulation of Three-phase High Power Factor Converter Based on One-cycle Control
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: One-cycle control technology is used for three-phase high power factor converter, one-cycle control equation is presented, the corresponding control circuit and main circuit are designed, and a simulation study is done. Simulation results shows that the input current of three-phase high power factor converter can track the input voltage very well, a unity power factor correction is achieved, and the control mode is simple, it has fast dynamic response and high reliability.

articleTitle: Research on the Behavior Model of Enterprise Network Agent
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Although the enterprise network has a variety of forms, they all have the basic characteristics of CAS: Aggregation, Identification, Nonlinear, Stream, Diversity, Internal model and Building blocks. Enterprise network is made of a number of agents who are relatively autonomous and intelligent, which has active adaptive, multi-hierarchy nature, open, non-linear (butterfly effect), synergy and learning together and other characteristics. Based on stimulus - response model of CAS theory, the article built the behavioral model of enterprise network agents. Behavioral model of the enterprise network consists of three main parts: a detector, an effecter and a set of IF / THEN rules. Rules here have two meanings: one is the set of behavior rules among agents in enterprise network, the other is the set of behavior rules between agents in enterprise network. Connection between agents in enterprise network is generated through the rules changing constantly, the change of rules is completed through the distribution of rules and the discovery of new rules.

articleTitle: Discussion on Geometric Algorithms of Ultrasonic Waves Reflected Path
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we discussed the problem of the ultrasonic reflected path in the body area network. Through the establishment of the corresponding simple mathematical model, we analyzed the problems of the angle of reflection and the number of the reflection. We discussed primarily the mathematical model of ultrasound application in the body area network.

articleTitle: New Technology for License Plate Location and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A simple and efficient license plate location and recognition technology is proposed and tested. This new technology considers the gray location and edge information available through searching jumping change in a license plate area. Segmentation method is used to improve the traditional projection method. Template matching method and statistics are applied for final recognition. Tests show that this new technology meets with practical needs.

articleTitle: Bifurcation Solutions and Stability of Predator-prey System with Beddington-DeAngelis Functional Responses
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, A predator-prey system with Beddington-DeAngelis functional responses is investigated. The unique existence and stability of bifurcation solution which bifurcates from double multiplicity eigenvalue are obtained by Lyapunov-Schmidt procedure and mathematic computation.

articleTitle: Statistical Analysis of Research Papers on Computional Grid Technology in China
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The last decade witnessed a substantial increase in the development of computing grid, mainly as a result of faster hardware and more sophisticated software. Grid computing is a term referring to the combination of computer resources from multiple administrative domains to reach a common goal. It links together computing resources such as PCs, workstations, servers, storage elements, and provides the mechanism needed to access them. This paper will give a brief description to grid computing firstly, and then illustrate how grid technology develops in China by the analysis of four aspects(Annual distributions, Journals, authors and keywords)of papers published in core journals.

articleTitle: How to Use Composite Materials to Design and Manufacture the Medical Cover Mold of Gamma Knife
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The medical cover mold of Gamma Knife is abnormal-shaped product, the design and manufacture of the molds must fit the own distinguishing features of composite materials, and also should satisfy the demand of the function and appearance of products, During design procedure, we must make the perfect combination of those two points and consider the general character of the materials and the product requirements, in doing this the products can be produced.

articleTitle: Research on Battlefield Target Value Evaluation Model Based on Improved BP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Target value evaluation is the core task in the battlefield information processing. How to evaluate the value of targets and calculate their priorities based on battlefield target information and the combat mission is a focuses problem in the modern war. To solve the problem, some comprehensive evaluation indexes for the targets are created and an evaluation model based on the improved BP algorithm for targets value is proposed in this paper. The result of simulation proves the validity of this algorithm. It's helpful to use this model in choosing the fire attack objects in practice.

articleTitle: Optimization of Multi-level Inventory of Random Demand Based on Co-evolutionary Genetic Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Considering a random feature can be found on the demand of ordnance maintenance material, Under the hypothesis that the ordering police of both campaign storage and tactical warehouses is of periodical inspection, the mathematic models of optimizing periodical inspection interval and order quantity at the same time are established and solved using co-evolutionary genetic algorithm, An example verifies the effectiveness of the models and algorithm.

articleTitle: Method for Improving Transmission Efficiency in 40Gbit/s System Based on Dispersion Compensation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In an effort to overcome the problem that the transmission efficiency is too low in 40Gbit/s system, a method based on dispersion compensation is provided. Firstly, the application background of 40Gbit/s system, the key using technologies and the shortcomings and advantages of 40Gbit/s system are possessed. Secondly, an application program of 40Gbit/s system based on dispersion compensation is given. At the same time, this program is analyzed. Thirdly, this program is compared with another program which has been widely used in 40Gbit/s system. Finally, the compared results show that this program is able to improve the transmission efficiency apparently.

articleTitle: Study on the Wireless Network Localization Based on ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of modern communication technology and wireless network, Positioning demand is increasing. Especially in special environments, such as supermarket, warehouses, exhibition halls, library, underground parking, mine and so on. In all these cases, the location information of Mobile terminal or its holder, facilities and materials need to be identified, But as the limitation of positioning time, positioning accuracy as well as the complexity of the environment conditions, well-positioning technology is still unable to be used. This paper mainly research the basic principles of ZigBee wireless networks and positioning technologies, analyze their strengths and weaknesses and design a suitable positioning method of community treatment system.

articleTitle: A Set Extension of Prolog: The Definitions
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper we propose a set extension of Prolog, SEProlog, so that sets can be constructed in logic programming. In SEProlog sets are defined intensively, so it has a strong capability in creating sets. To avoid any possible confusions in the set construction levels, a basic notion "order" which is assigned to every set and formula of SEProlog is introduced with which such paradoxes as "the set of all sets" or "a set containing itself" will not be possible to be constructed in our proposal even when sets in it are defined intensively. Three deductive rules are also introduced in this paper, which make SEProlog strong in deductions and programming even when sets are involved in deductions.

Author Keywords: the order of a set or a predicate

articleTitle: Research on Behavior-based Detection Method for Mobile Application Security
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A detection method based on behaviors of running mobile applications is proposed in this paper. It can detect all mobile application software and judge whether they are tampered or harmful. Further more, applications are signed and then the authoritative white list library can be established. Therefore, the events of mutual malicious detection between companies can be avoided.

articleTitle: On How Stop the Loopholes in Windows 2003
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Though widely-known for its security and stability, window 2003 has some loopholes due to its default configuration. For the sake of security, it is necessary to change the default configuation so as to stop the loopholes and ensure the security of the system and information.

articleTitle: Design and Implement of a Network Video Monitoring System Based on DM6446
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Design and implementation of network video monitoring system is introduced in this paper. The DM6446 of TI DaVinci series which combines the digital signal processing technology is used as the master chip of this system and the strong ability in data processing is shown. Its system hardware is with sample interface and the software with perfect function, and the testing results indicate that this network video monitoring system is designed with high stability, good image quality, good network transmission performance, and has good practical applications.

articleTitle: The Personal User Interface Based on Multi-agent and System Construction
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Without personalization is a serious limitation of today's information service, in view of which and the advantage of the agent technology, a kind of user interface profile based on multi-agent has been designed in order to make information retrieval easy, and its concrete description has also been given. The agent technology has provided us a kind of completely different information service pattern, which probably can improve the efficiency of information retrieval significantly.

articleTitle: An Analytical Approach for Strongly Nonlinear Oscillator Arising in the Micro-Electromechanical System (MEMS)
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this study, the homotopy analysis method is used to obtain the asymptotic analytical solutions for the seventh-order temporal problem corresponds to a strongly nonlinear vibration arising in the microbeam-based microelectro mechanical system (MEMS). Numerical comparisons are conducted between the results obtained by the homotopy analysis and those analytical numerical results given in the literatures for authenticating the accuracy and correctness of this approach.

articleTitle: A Novel Stopping Criterion for BICM-ID Based on SNR Estimation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Iterative decoding algorithm is an valid method to ameliorate the performance of system receiver. It has been used in Bit-interleaved coded modulation (BICM) for overcoming the drawback of BICM over AWGN channels. Since the iterative algorithm increase the complexity of the receiver and incur larger delay, a novel iterative decoding scheme using an optimal iterative scheme for Bit-interleaved coded modulation with iterative decoding (BICM-ID) is proposed in this paper. Different from the conventional iterative decoding scheme for BICM-ID, this proposed scheme can stop iteration by analyses a tabulation which shows the relationship between SNR point and the relevant BER for each iteration. Simulation results show that the proposed iterative decoding scheme can not only reduce the meaningless iterations effectively but also lessen the BER when SNR is higher than a certain value.

articleTitle: Optimization Study for Lightweight Set Protocol
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: As an important part of the e-commerce, the Internet-based electronic trading has caused widespread concern. SET transaction is the key factor of electronic trading and its process is very complicated. In this paper, SET protocol is focused, which consists of purchase request, payment verification and secure payment. First, the trade process is classified according to the different transaction amount, and then the lightweight transaction process is optimized and SPIN model of SET protocol is tested. Finally, the SET protocol is improved according to the simulation and testing results.

articleTitle: A Wrapper of PCI Express with FIFO Interfaces Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a PCI Express (PCIE) Wrapper core named PWrapper with FIFO interfaces. Compared with other PCIE solutions, PWrapper has several advantages such as flexibility, isolation of clock domain, etc. PWrapper is implemented and verified on Vertex-5-FX70T which is a development board provided by Xilinx Inc. Architecture of PWrapper and design of two key modules are illustrated, which timing optimization methods have been adopted. Then we explained the advantages and challenges of on-chip interfaces technology based on FIFOs. The verification results show that PWrapper can achieve the speed of 1.8Gbps (Giga bits per second).

articleTitle: Research on Network Location Problem of Equipment Support Force Spatial Configuration
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Equipment support force spatial configuration (ESFSC), as an important content of equipment support command, has a direct influence on equipment support time-efficiency. On the basis of analyzing the characteristic of ESFSC, this paper makes the orientation for the ESFSC problem in the network location domain, and makes the network location extense model of ESFSC based on multiple objective decision-making (MODM) theory, and uses genetic algorithm (GA) to solve the ESFSC problem. Experimental results reflect that the method proposed by this paper has good flexibleness and operability, can satisfy the complex need of ESFSC and has good applied values.

articleTitle: Second and Third Moments Characteristics of Electricity Price Volatility
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The distribution properties of electricity prices are the important information for the risk management of electricity markets and the pricing of electricity financial derivatives. With comprehensive consideration of the changing rules of the electricity spot price, a multicycle GARCH-M model based on Gram-Charlier series expansion of the normal density function is proposed, in which the second moment, third moment and multicycle of electricity price series are described by time-varying variance, time-varying skewness and sine function. The changing trend, volatility of second and third moments, multicycle and the relationship among load and spot price can be fully taken into account. The numerical example based on the historical data of the PJM market shows that time-varying variance and the system load square have a significant effect on the mean electricity prices, there exist second moment volatility clustering and weekly, semi-monthly, monthly, bimonthly, quarterly and semi-annual periods, and the second and third moments of electricity price series manifest the clear synchronous time-varying characteristics.

articleTitle: The Settings of Multi-parameter in Enumeration Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on the study of enumeration algorithm, the paper proposes the multi-parameter setting method in enumeration algorithm parameter values to achieve operation independence of parameters. That is: in order to achieve the independence of variable values, and in order to facilitate program design, if there were m variables in enumeration algorithm and each variable may have n states, the value of the n states could be set at a geometric sequence, the ratio of which is not less than m+1. articleTitle: Energy Saving and Emission Reduction Evaluation of Mountain City Traffic of Road Based on AHP-Entropy
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Traffic industry is aggravating the energy-consumption and emission of exhaust gas, although providing powerful support for economic and social development. A comprehensive evaluation model is constructed used the Entropy and AHP (analytic hierarchy process), in which the Energy saving and emission reduction evaluation indexes of road traffic have been established. And the energy saving and emission reduction of a mountain city is evaluated used the model, which prove that the AHP-Entropy evaluation model is effective and correct.

articleTitle: Simulation Training System of Airborne Early Warning Based on Intelligence Decision-making
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Intelligent decision support was used to the simulation training system of airborne early warning. The system was designed and modeled through expert system's qualitative analysis and decision support system's quantitative analysis, and it was implemented by using MapX under the platform .NET. The system can provide the intelligent decision-making support for the airborne early warning crews.

articleTitle: Efficient Simulation of Ocean and Land Scene Based on Digital Earth
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The efficient and realistic simulation of ocean and land scenes is one of the hotspot and difficult problems of computer graphic. Most simulation of the recent ocean and land scenes is based on plane and is in a limited region. They didn't consider the factors of earth curvature, nor the edge between ocean and land, can't be used on digital earth. In this paper, a new method of GPU-based simulation of large-scope ocean and land scenes is presented. It not only considers the factor of earth curvature, but also the edge between ocean and land, can be used on digital earth. First, ocean wave model considering sphere curvature is presented. Then, the visible part of the ocean surface is sampled with screen-subdivision algorithm.
