Finally, the cost computation of vertexes and color of ocean wave are performed by the programmability of the modern GPU. Results show that the method is efficient and users can fly over ocean and land surface of digital globe in interactive rates on common PC graphics hardware.

articleTitle: A Research of Attacking Access Controls Algorithms of Web Application
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Web Application on the Internet (WAoI) has inherent and unique characteristics rather than traditional networks. They have many different constraint's factors, such as quantity of network server, nodes of clients, statistics of network switches and routing paths, security and authentication of accessing, configuration and performance of hardware devices, computational power, storage capacity, and et al. Attacking occurrence in Internet web server leads to increasing packet loss and leak of Information. Even more which affects web application's efficiency is providing fairness in web data transition and time consumption. In this paper, an Attacking Access Controls algorithm is proposed. The proposed approach is common HTTP, and URLs protocols, which try to manage web sessions between client side and server side in the Internet. It implies that the Attacking Access Controls Algorithm has more important and achieved its goals in this paper.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Method to Extend the Motor Life
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper describes the basic principles of motor fault diagnosis, and a variety of diagnostic methods and their respective advantages and disadvantages; and describes a more advanced off-line prediction of international life of the new motor way.

articleTitle: Application of Grid Nesting Techniques on Cuace-Dust
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the grid nesting techniques and their application on the sand-dust storm forecasting model CUACE-Dust (CMA unified Atmosphere Chemistry Environment-Dust), which is coupled with PSU/NCAR mesoscale model. Based on CUACE-Dust, three numerical experiments are designed to show the advantage of the grid nesting techniques. In the key area that attracts attention, the nesting techniques help us get a result as good as that of the finer grid for the total area, but its time cost has been decreased to about 1/6.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of MMO Games in Education
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In the basis of analysis of education potential of MMO (Massively Multiplayer Online) game, combining massively multiplayer online game in the present situation of the application of education teaching, discusses the massively multiplayer online games in the education teaching, so as to the theory foundation education in massively multiplayer online game, the reasonable application of teaching theory, and finally, put forward expectations about massively multiplayer online game in future education teaching.

articleTitle: Research on State Monitor Techniques for Electronic Systems Based on HSMM
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: It is difficult to monitor electronic systems' early faults, so a Hidden Semi-Markov Model (HSMM) was introduced in order to solve the problem, and the electronic systems state monitor model based on HSMM was designed. The faint changes of early faults were replaced by the values of likelihood which changed markedly to estimate the healthy condition of the electronic systems, and the application examples indicated that the effect was good.

articleTitle: Research on a New Model System Based on Improved Process and Measurement Models
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on the characteristic and dedicated field of an enterprise and feature of its internal projects, a new set of clear and proper CMMI model system is described briefly by the example of process and measurement models involved in software requirement.

articleTitle: Effect Factors of Search Efficiency and its Optimization Methods in the Hybrid P2P Systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The resource searching efficiency is the most important performance in the hybrid Peer-to-Peer (P2P) systems. In this paper, we give the effect factors of search efficiency and its optimization methods in the hybrid P2P systems based on the analysis of evaluation criterion of search mechanism in the P2P systems. Firstly, we present the evaluation criterion of search mechanism in the aspects of users and systems, as for users, including the number of results, accuracy rate and response time, and for systems including search efficiency, scalability and robustness. Furthermore, we analyze the effect factors of search efficiency such as the performance of superpeers, the load of superpeers, and the index information in the hybrid P2P systems, and give some optimization methods divided three classes: topological optimization in the superpeer layer, superpeers selecting and route selecting.

articleTitle: Digital Technology in the Application of Sports Fields
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The literature research methods, induction of digital technology in the application of professional sports. Describes the selection of athletes for sports figures, professional training, teaching, and sports figures to provide a reference for further research.

articleTitle: The Research and Implementation of PDH Network Management Software for Telecom Access Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper aimed at the situation that the backbone network of modern telecom was using advanced SDH technology and standard mainstream products, meanwhile the edge of the access network was using traditional PDH technology and products, then a problem which was the coexistence of PDH and SDH technology in same network was produced. Now how to solve the intelligent management of edge devices in PDH network has become an important research topic to access network security management. Through VxWorks real-time operating system platform and "host - target" embedded cross-compiler development environment, using tornado as software development tool, the design and development of PDH network management software had been achieved in this paper. The running test results of software system proved that the system could realize intelligent management of edge devices in PDH network.

articleTitle: Underwater Localization Iterative Algorithm based on Geomagnetic Anomaly Inversion
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The position of underwater vehicle relative to target is determined by magnetic field magnitude and gradients of target on condition that geomagnetic anomaly can be inversed as a magnetic dipole target. The magnetic field is measured by the device installed on vehicle and composed of ten single-axis magnetometers. Because the noise of magnetometers results in the coefficients of a six-order equation with one variable inaccurate, it will put obscure influence on the localization precision. The statistical properties of these coefficients are analyzed theoretically, and their means and variances are deduced considering Gaussian noises of magnetometers. However, it is difficult to determinate the detailed expression of statistic distribution. A localization iterative algorithm is put forward and described, and its astringency is discussed theoretically and simulated numerically. These results show favorable astringency for the iterative algorithm, which can improve remarkably the localization precision.

articleTitle: The Analysis of the Basic Model of the Multilayer Client-Server Queuing Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The main concept of the multilayer client-server queuing network model method is called the basic model. This basic model can be decomposed into two sub-models: client sub-model and server sub-model. These two sub-models can be solved using traditional queuing network analysis method such as MVA algorithm. It is proposed to predict performance of distributed software system based on existed queuing network analysis technique. The client sub-model calculates think time for server sub-model, and the server sub-model calculates waiting time for client sub-model. The overall model can be solved by iteration from one sub-model to the next sub-model. Then the basic model is extended to multiplayer client-server queuing network. This solution for multilayer client-server queuing network is called NLQN.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Open-Pit Slope in Rock Movement Zone Based on Simulation and BP Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the stability problems of rock moving zone slope in Sanyou Limestone Mine and using elastic-plastic finite element theory by ANSYS software as analysis tools, the stability of side slope in typical section is simulated and analyzed. BP neutral network is also used to verify the results of simulation to further improve the reliability of the forecast and work out optimal value of final open-pit slope angle in the rock moving zone.

articleTitle: A New Digital Image Restoration Model Based on Local Constraints
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a new digital image restoration model based on local constraints is proposed with attempting to address the problems of the classical TV (total variation) restoration model and the p-Laplace model. To this end, we adopt the adaptive regulation in this proposed model, which differs from the global regulation used in the classical TV restoration mode and the p-Laplace model. The proposed model can not only preserve and enhance edge and boundary features but also avoid the staircase effect. An efficient numerical schema is used for the implementation of the model. Experimental results on image denoising and deblurring represent that the proposed model is better than the classical TV restoration mode and the p-Laplace model.

articleTitle: Intelligent Fault Diagnosis of Rotating Machinery Based on Grey Similar Relation Degree
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: After deeply studying the relationship between reason and symptom of the fault, a novel intelligent fault diagnosis method was proposed based on grey similar relation degree. Firstly, the definition of grey relation degree was introduced. Secondly, on the base of analyzing the defects existed in the grey relation degree, the definition of grey similar relation degree was introduced. Thirdly, the symptom set and standard fault set had been established based on the known knowledge, experience and fault examples. Finally, the grey similar relation degree was used to describe the similarity between the faults and symptoms. Even the fault information was imperfect and the fault mechanism was not clear, the results of diagnosis would be more correct than before. The practical results show that this approach is quite efficient and intelligent. It's suitable for on-line monitoring and diagnosis of rotating machinery.

articleTitle: H8 Robust Fault Tolerant Control for a Class of Nonlinear Descriptor Systems with Time-varying Delays
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The problems of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> robust fault tolerant control are studied for a class of nonlinear Descriptor systems with time-varying delays. The T-S fuzzy model is employed to represent a nonlinear system, for the actuator fault of systems with disturbance, the state feedback controller is designed. The sufficient conditions are obtained based on Lyapunov asymptotic stability theory and linear matrix inequality method, which are dependent on time delays and satisfies the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> performance index of the system. The relationship among the terms of the nonlinear system and the relationship among the terms in the Leibniz-Newton formula are expressed by introducing some free weighting matrices. This treatment avoids difficulties and blindness in the handing of the Lyapunov function, and less conservative results are obtained. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Research on Environmental Information System Based on Flex and MAPGIS K9 IMS
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: It is very important to protect the natural environment. Presenting environmental information to the public with the intention of enhancing the understanding of the environment and promoting environmental awareness requires the creation of a new type of environmental information system for the general public(PEIS). The eco-geochemistry information is main information that the public wants to obtain and comprehend through the WWW. Through a practical case study, the eco-geomistry information system to publish in the web is explained in detail. The functions of the system include map display, map output, data query, statistical analysis, environmental evaluation, etc. The paper introduces the technique of Flex and MapGIS K9 IMS, and how to integrate these technique. The principles and methods are not only applicable to the eco-geochemisty information system, but also to any other information system sharing information in the web.

articleTitle: Tree-based Delay Guaranteed and Energy Efficient MAC Protocol for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: TDGEE is a cross-layered TDMA-based MAC protocol, which is energy efficient and delay guaranteed based on the tree topology. The protocol first enables the network to construct an energy-balanced tree topology. Then each node collects its local topology information in one hop. A distributed time slot assignment algorithm determines when each node should transmit and receive the data packets. The nodes can be sychronized by coordination messages broadcasted from the sink. Since the propocol, which uses distributed algorithm, has the adjustment mechanism, the TDGEE network is highly scalable and flexible. The performance of TDGEEis compared with existing protocols by simulations. For the network application we considering, the TDGEE network provides bounded delay guarantee and longer network lifetime than other protocols, making sensor network economically viable.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Starting Performance of Low Power Induction Motor with Compound Cage Rotor
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A low power induction motor with compound cage rotor is illustrated in this paper. Permeability and conducting material is inset in the bar, which forms novel induction motor with compound cage rotor. Considering the feasibility of technology, two kinds of rotor slot shape are designed. Then the starting and operating performance of the motor is calculated by 2D finite element model of electromagnetic field[1]. Meanwhile, the height of compound material in the bar is changed to analysing the influence of starting and operating performance by it. The conclusion prove that the novel induction motor with compound cage rotor has batter starting performance than the common induction motor with the same seat No.

articleTitle: lmproved JPDA Algorithm with Measurements Adaptively Censored
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: For the problem of tracking multiple targets in dense clutter with missed detections, the JPDA approach has shown to tend to coalesce neighboring tracks. To improve this situation, the paper proposed an improved approach to adaptively censor the measurements for the state updating by setting a censoring threshold. Monte Carlo simulations with Matlab show that the method is an effective way to avoid track coalescence. On the crossing point of two targets, the position RMS error of the proposed filter appeared to outperform that of the Scaled JPDA proposed in literature. On the remainder of the simulation time, they appeared to perform similarly. The proposed method, therefore, is capable of avoiding track coalescence with less position RMS error.

articleTitle: Parallel Motion Compensation Interpolation in H.264/AVC Using Graphic Processing Units
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Motion compensation interpolation is an important part in H.264 codec. With the growing interest on high-definition (HD) contents, it is important to find methods to reduce the time cost of motion compensation interpolation which has greatly hindered the implementation of real time coding for HD contents. In this paper, a forward step is developed towards the implementation of interpolation algorithm into a Graphic Processing Units (GPU) using Compute Unified Device Architecture (CUDA). The proposed algorithm has achieved high parallelism on GPU at pixel level. Experimental results show our proposed solution on GPU can be up to 193.61% over traditional method on Central Processing Unit (CPU) without introducing any distortions and leads to a CPU usage reduction at the same time, since the massive parallel processing capability of GPU is efficiently harnessed.

articleTitle: The Data Format Transformation of Sea Surface Temperature Data
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper introduced the SST(Sea Surface Temperature) data structure of FY-3(FengYun-3) satellite and Fortran unformatted sequential access file structure. The principle of big-endian and little-endian is demonstrated, and the method of reading the SST data of FY-3 satellite is proposed.

articleTitle: Infrared Complex Background Suppression Based on Vision Perception Model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: To improve the detection performance for weak and small targets signal in complex infrared background, such as the ground and the cloud, the small target background suppression algorithm based on vision perception model (VPM) is presented. Firstly, with simple cell receptive field model, original infrared image is decomposed to two images by different Gabor functions using convolution. And then, the nonlinear convergence function of complex cell response is utilized to fusion two images obtained by separation small target with background clutter in infrared image. Finally, the target image is obtained by using classical adaptive threshold method. Several groups of experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can suppress the infrared background effectively, compared with several classical infrared dim and small target background suppression methods, such as local means remove and two-dimensional least means square filter methods.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Emulation of Store Reliability of the Drag Parachute System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: By fault tree analysis and Monte Carlo, the paper takes MATLAB to simulate the reliability of drag parachute system of an air bomb. The result shows that the MTTF of drag parachute system is 21 years which is basically consistent to the fact.

articleTitle: Selection of the PSO Parameters for Inverting of Ellipsometry
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: To guarantee the convergence of PSO applied to the inverting of ellipsometry to the global optima in good time, the optimization performance of PSO under different parameters is compared and analyzed. The result shows that the range of inertia weight ω from 0.5 to 0.8, the sum of learning parameters c<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, c<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> preferably not more than 3, and at the same time, a smaller c<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and a bigger c<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, ensure the better optimization performance of PSO.

articleTitle: KPI Corporate Management and Business Intelligence Analysis on the Application of Electric Power Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The breakthrough to promote the operation and management capacity of electric power enterprises lies in the construction of a new-generation integral decision analysis platform specialized in integrating indicator management, subject analysis and theme analysis. By combining the respective advantages of the management of key performance indicator system and business intelligence, the decision analysis platform adopts indicator as business orientation, data warehouse as the cornerstone, and business intelligence analytical tool as terminal application. Through the proposition of overall planning of the subject domain of business intelligence of electric power enterprises, and the comprehensive utilization of data warehouse, on-line analysis and processing, and mathematical analysis model, etc., customized view is provided for management staff and operation staff at various levels. In this way, the ability to acquire management analysis information of the enterprises can be expected to improve, which will further promote the quality and speed of management and decision.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Accounting Information Based on Events Approach
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the booming development of Modern information technology revolution, accounting environment has been greatly changed, and the traditional accounting information system already cannot satisfy the diversity and personalized needs of enterprise stakeholders. This paper is meeting the needs of corporate stakeholders on event accounting approach, it introduces event vouchers in the economic transaction and operational matters process, realizes the event information and accounting information system's seamless docking, and then with the "three-base system" as the design ideas, finally constructs the accounting information system based on events approach.

articleTitle: Clouds and Clouds Shadows Detection and Matching in MODIS Multispectral Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Due to weather influence, it is difficult to obtain cloud-free images in MODIS multispectral remote sensing data. Most remote sensing images are more or less influenced by clouds and cloud shadows in data acquisition processing, which cause serious problems for data application. As a result, many researchers have presented effective methods to detect and remove these clouds and their shadows from remote sensing images. However, there is still important clouds three-dimensional information included in cloud shadows based on the principle of shadow imaging, for example, cloud height. Therefore, through analyzing and extracting the features of clouds and cloud shadows, the information of cloud height can be further detected. In this paper, clouds and cloud shadows detection and matching methods are discussed for MODIS multispectral satellite data. The research results can be further applied to detect cloud height, which support wider application fields for remote sensing data application.

articleTitle: Research on Method of Double-Layers BP Neural Network in Bicycle Flow Prediction
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The prediction of bicycle flow is important in intelligent transportation systems in China. This research aimed at using double-layers BP neural network to predict bicycle flow of Jingshi Road in Jinan City. The results of the computer simulation showed that the method was applicable, and the average relative tolerance was 4.65%. The double-layers BP neural network can be used to forecast bicycle flow.

articleTitle: SVM-based Multi-textural Image Classification and its Uncertainty Analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Texture analysis, a hot issue in image processing, is a key technique for ground surface object recognition. This paper presents a supervised image classification method based on multiple and multi-scale texture features and support vector machines (SVM). By taking different scales of ground surface features into account, and by feature fusion technique, this method integrates seven-dimensional texture features of different characteristics from GLCM and fractal theory to realize the land use/cover classification. The seven features combine the abilities to describe image textures of different approaches, which can reach better classification performance than any of them and significantly improves the precision of automatic image interpretation. Classification uncertainty is also evaluated and analyzed at the scale of pixel using the extended probability vector and probability entropy model. The imagery used in this research is RADARSAT-1 SAR data.

articleTitle: A Novel Cluster-Based Architecture of Cognitive Wireless Ad-Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Cognitive radio (CR) technology makes spectrum usage paradigm shifting from the traditional command and control allocation scheme to the open spectrum allocation scheme. With the introduction of CR, wireless ad-hoc networks meet new opportunities and challenges. Motivated by the CogMesh network, this paper proposes a novel cluster-based CogAd-hoc architecure. The CogAd-hoc network provide a new kind of cooperation mode which improves the efficiency of data forwarding and has excellent load balance feature. This paper gives the overview of the CogAd-hoc network and identifies issues in such a network.

articleTitle: A Weight-Based Attack Model in Road Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Recently, several techniques have been proposed to preserve the user location privacy in road networks. To protect the location privacy of users, many of the existing techniques adopt cloaking which blurs the actual location into a set of segments. But these techniques do not take the weight of the segments into account in the situation of road networks. In this paper, we propose a new attack model that an adversary can infer the true location of the requester according to the weight distribution with a certain probability. And we also design an approach to solve this problem, which can guarantee better distribution of the weights in the cloaked set. The experiment result shows the effectiveness and feasibility of our algorithm.

articleTitle: Use of Remote Sensing and GIS to Assess the Effects of Agricultural Land Production Capacity on Spatial Extension of Construction Land in Chengdu
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: As a major commodity grain base in the Chengdu Plain, the city of Chengdu has played a significant role in the grain security of the Sichuan Province and the stability of national economy. However, with the urbanization process, the cultivated land quantity reduces and quality drops, which further affect the security of the grain production. In this study, we integrate remote sensing and geographic information systems to detect land-use change and reveal the increase in urban built-up land between 1992 and 2002. The result shows that the built-up land increased from 31280 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> to 41196 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The net gain of the built-up land was 9916 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> between 1992 and 2002. The quality of the cultivated land was in the third, fourth, fifth, and sixth grades, occupying 0.02%, 87.70%, 5.53%, and 6.75%, respectively. Meanwhile, according to the database of soil attributes and spatial parameters in classification and gradation for farming land in Chengdu, the correlation relationship between the land utilization index and the realistic productivity was established. The results indicated that the cultivated land with high productivity and favorable facilities in the suburbs was decreasing much faster because of their close contiguity to the expanding city, and the total loss of the capacity of cultivated land caused by land shrinkage reached 1.48 ×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> tons.

articleTitle: A Tentative Analysis of the Intrusion and Defence of Trojans
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The present paper first discusses the harm that trojians do to servers and then, taking into consideration the characteristics of trojians, offers some suggestions and ways to defend trojians so as to make servers more stable and safer.

articleTitle: A Scheme for Symbol Timing and Synchronization Based on DSP Implementation in TD-LTE System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: As a key technology in next generation mobile communication standards, OFDM is used in downlink data transmission in LTE system, not only reaching the spectrum flexibility requirements, but also realizing higher peak data rate. However it is very sensitive to frequency offset, which has stricter demands on time and frequency synchronization. In this paper, we primarily focus on synchronization algorithm in time domain and then propose its improved algorithm. The simulation results indicate that the symbol timing and synchronization can be effectively and accurately estimated in the improved algorithm. In addition, a symbol timing and synchronization process based on DSP implementation is presented subsequently.

articleTitle: Quantitative Detection for Gas Mixtures Based on the Adaptive Genetic Algorithm and BP Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on the advantages and disadvantages of genetic algorithm (GA) and artificial neural network (ANN), an optimization model with the adaptive genetic algorithm and the traditional BP neural network is presented for the quantitative detection of gas mixtures. To overcome the disadvantages of ANN with inherent slowly searching rate and partially leading to minimum, the adaptive genetic algorithm is used to get better initial weights and thresholds of the BP network in the early stage, which combines the advantages of genetic algorithm with parallel-computing and strong whole searching capacity. In the later, the network is trained by the error back propagation method. A three-layer 7×18×3 BP network is designed for a group of gas mixtures with five samples. The results show that the convergence speed and the learn precision of adaptive genetic algorithm optimizing neural network are better than that of the traditional BP algorithm, which can make shorter the calculation time three times at the begin of the same weights and thresholds and at the end of global error with the magnitude of 0.00001.The application of GA optimizing BP network to the recognition of gas mixtures is reliable and the method can improve the detection efficiency of gas mixtures, which can give some references for developing intelligent detection apparatus.

articleTitle: Shandong Unicom Optical Cable Line Resource Information System Based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: For Shandong Unicom, there are kinds of business needs. The main businesses are telephone services and internet services, all of these services require resources, especially optical cable line resources. If the resources can be clearly known, that is to say that the resources are made a good use of, the economic benefit will reach its maximization. The problems mentioned above can be solved by this optical cable line resource information system which is a part of the pipeline resource information system. The optical cable line resources' feature including spatial location feature and attribute feature is displayed more directly by the optical cable line resource information system based on GIS.

articleTitle: Unified Trusted Measurement Model of Trusted Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the current situation of trust measurement mechanism which lacks systematic measurement model, basing on Identity Authentication and static integrity, this paper provides a unifying trusted measurement model (UTM). With trusted measurement of integrated identity, status trusted measurement, behavior trusted measurement, and this model establishes a unifying trusted measurement of trusted network. The model is a static and dynamic measurement. It integrates multi-dimension elements and has the features of fine-grained, dynamic, supporting for behavior measurement. It provides a good base for developing more fine-grained security policy.

articleTitle: An Improved SVM-KM Model for Imbalanced Datasets
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Support vector machine is a widely used machine learning technique. SVM-KM model can speed SVM training by eliminating non support vectors, but imbalanced datasets will affect the classification accuracy. In this paper, we proposed an improved SVM-KM model, which assign different error costs to different classes. Based on the simulation results, the improved SVM-KM model performed best for imbalanced datasets.

articleTitle: Decentralized Metadata Management Research Based on Distributed Hash Table Technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A methodology of decentralized metadata management has been proposed within this paper that data and metadata from server-side can be distributed to the various network nodes. This methodology supports large capacity work machines to read and write data in parallel when running data-intensive applications on the platform, with random access, flexible access granularity, and supports concurrent read/write characteristics of high data load. By applying distributed hash table technology, bulk metadata can be divided into the form of tree-structure of segmentation tree. The data and metadata of read/write and new data appended to process are described. The test results show that this methodology can get high bandwidth of aggregation and average bandwidth of read/write when working in different parallel access with read/write process.

articleTitle: RIP Internet Protocol Failure Analysis and Research
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Analysis and research of information and Internet protocol version RIP authentication key does not match the two common faults, And propose solutions to improve the packet transmission efficiency and reduce message latency.

articleTitle: A New Stopping Criterion for BICM-ID System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Bit-interleaved coded modulation with iterative decoding (BICM-ID) is a better scheme than BICM through applying iterative decoding algorithm at the receiver. It can get excellent performances both in AWGN and in Rayleigh fading channels. However, the iterative algorithm increases the complexity of the receiver and leads to much decoding delay. Thus, the stopping criterion, which can timely terminate the unnecessary decoding iterations, is put forward. In this paper, based on the cross-entropy (CE) concept, we propose a new method named LLR (log-likelihood-ratio) stopping criterion. Simulation results show that without any exponential computation, the proposed LLR scheme can take a better trade off between the average iteration numbers and the bit-error-rate (BER) performance degradation. Although with a little more iterative numbers than CE at high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) sections, it obtains excellent BER performance as compensation. More importantly, besides the less iteration numbers, the LLR scheme performs even better than the fixed scheme at high SNR sections in terms of BER performance.

Author Keywords: bit-interleaved coded modulation with iterative decoding (BICM-ID)

articleTitle: Oscillation of Even Order Damped Neutral Delay Differential Equations with Mixed Nonlinearities
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: By means of Riccati transformation technique and inequalities, we study the even order damped neutral delay differential equations with mixed nonlinearities. Three sufficient conditions are obtained for oscillatory behavior of the equation which extend and improve some known results in literature.

articleTitle: Sa Evaluation Model of Food Supply Chain Stability
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The efficiency of supply chain is depends on the stable operation of the food supply chain. However, food supply chains suffer many disturbances in recent years, which causes low stability of the supply chain, and low efficiency of supply chain, and even leads to the collapse of the entire supply chain. So this paper try to set up an evaluation model of food supply chain stability based on unascertained measure and comentropy theory. This paper summaries different kinds factors affecting food supply chain stability from existing articles, and uses unascertained measure to find out the distribution probability matrix of secondary indicators. Then the paper uses comentropy theory to find out the weight of first-class indicators. Based on the findings of distribution probability matrix and weight of first-class indicators, the paper finally puts forward a evaluation model to measures the stability of food supply chain and also gives a numeric example to demonstrate the efficiency and reliability of the evaluation model.

articleTitle: Design of Vertical Transportation System Driven by Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor Signal Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor(PMLSM) Vertical Transportation system is a new kind of ropeless hoisting system. In addition to the complications of dynamic state characteristic, the examination of some signals is also very difficult. In this paper, DSP is used to examine and process the signal. The designs of hardware and software were introduced in detail. The experiments show that the effect of this signal acquisition system is better.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Taxi Billing System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we design a taxi billing system based on FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array). The system was programmed by VHDL (Very High Speed Integrated Circuit Hardware Description Language), achieving setting module, billing module, display module and connect function. Compare with others, this system is good at small volume, high integration level, high reliability and convenience in maintenance and updating.

articleTitle: IDKeeper: A Web Password Manager with Roaming Capability Based on USB Key
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper presents an architecture that affords Web users a trusted ID/Password manager with roaming capability named IDKeeper. The design objectives of this solution are (i) to protect web users from phishing attacks especially malware-based phishing and web spoofing; (ii) to provide an easy-to-use system with roaming capability so that web user can focus on their transaction rather that security and they can use their credential information everywhere. At first, design principles are given based on the analysis of the existing attacks today. Secondly, the solution overview and usage overview are presented. Thirdly, we give the software architecture and the particular implementation. At last, the advantages of IDKeeper are given in conclusion. With IDKeeper, IDs and passwords are stored on users' USB Key, coupling ID/Password to users, not to their machines or to the third-party servers.

articleTitle: A Multi Trust Chain Scheme in Trusted Cross-Domain Interaction
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A formal trust chain model is proposed, which includes important concepts in trust chain such as trust root, expection, and it is able to represent measurement, extension and attestation processes. This model is a tool for researchers to research trust chain in theory. In the context of cross domain interaction, this paper shows the model deal with two trust chains to make two entities from different domain interact. At last, the effectiveness of this method in production information system is analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Grid-Based Management of Collaborative Logistics System Based on Internet
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The logistics industry in China is still in its developing stage. The majority of logistics enterprises are small and medium sized ones, have few service-functions, and serve small areas. Logistics alliance can improve Chinese logistics enterprises' strength greatly. This paper had a research on the grid-based management of collaborative logistics system based on Internet, and respectively, from the management perspective and technical perspective, discussed the feasibility, architecture and the key issues in the system's realization. Also the paper designed a platform frame for grid-based logistics management, proved its effectiveness, and thus provided a feasible solution for collaborative logistics management.

articleTitle: Networked Predictive Control Based on a State Observer
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Network delays are inevitable in networked control systems and have negative effects on system performance and stability. To compensate network delay actively, a novel networked predictive control scheme based on a state observer is proposed in this paper. A state observer reconstructs the current states using the delayed output and gains of the state observer are designed using LMI methods. Stability conditions of the closed-loop networked predictive control system are derived. Using these conditions, less conservative upper bound of delay, which guarantees the asymptotic stability of the system, is obtained. The evaluation illustrates the effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Efficient Search Scheme in Mobile Peer-to-Peer Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: These years mobile technology has developed rapidly and the P2P technology is also very popular used in wired network, with such trend, the combination of these 2 technologies, MP2P has appeared. Comparing to traditional P2P, MP2P has many limitations, such as the unreliable connection, limitation of bandwidth and also the battery power of the mobile terminal. These limitations make the resource search and information sharing impropriety and inefficiency in mobile network. This paper proposed a new scheme self-aware based on group in MP2P environment and also presented the algorithm implementation on it. The experiment shows that the scheme can really enhance the system performance and efficiency.

articleTitle: The Design and the Control Principle Analysis of a New Hybrid Excitation Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new type Hybrid Excitation Synchronous Generator (HESG). Its structure characteristics and operation principles are described. And also the calculation of 3D magnetic field of the HSEG is carried out by using Finite Element Method (FEM). The experiments prove that its structure is rational, the control principle is effective and the stable control on terminal voltage can be realized. This is beneficial in building the foundation theory of HESG analysis.

articleTitle: Hydraulic Support Four-bar Linkage Optimized Design Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Hydraulic support optimization can improve the capabilities of managing the roof and enduring the load of the standing shield's hydraulic support. In this paper, an improved particle swarm optimization (IPSO) algorithm is proposed to optimize the hydraulic support. In order to avoid the particles falling into local searching and improve the particles convergence rate, the strategy of updating the particle's velocity and location is improved, and a new nonlinearly decreasing function is constructed as inertia weight. Taking the length of four-bar linkage of hydraulic support as the optimal parameters and the maximal horizontal swing Δx of the move trace of the roof beam endpoint minimum as the optimal target, we build parameter optimization model of four-bar linkage based on IPSO and make comparison with analytical method. The results show that, the Δx is greatly reduced; the working status and support effect of hydraulic support is stable and favorable.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Middleware for RFID Warehouse Management
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a suitable solution for the tobacco warehouse management based on RFID technology is proposed. We first summarize the middleware system to achieve the main function, then design its structure and composition of the modules. Through experimental analysis, the middleware is layered and reconfigurable and it can well meet the needs of enterprises. At the same time, the application of RFID technology can collect data more accurately, fast and reliably. So the efficiency of management is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Dual Tree Complex Shearlet Transform and its Shift Invariance Properties
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In Shearlab, the publicized spatial implementation of Shearlet Transform is shift-variance because it is based on DWT, which is shift-variance. The deficiency of the spatial implementation scheme could be mitigated by the method of Dual Tree Complex Shearlet Transform (DT CST). In this paper, the definition of Complex Shearlet Transform is given, and then discussed the details of the DT CST about its theory, structure and implementation. Numerical results suggest that it is nearly shift-invariance.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Routing Algorithm based on Overlay Network for Wireless Ad Hoc Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Due to the dynamic topology of the wireless Ad Hoc network, the existing unicast routing protocol mainly applies the expensive flooding to find or maintain the path between source and destination. This essay, from the collaborative work of network layer and overlay layer, put forwards the hybrid unicast routing algorithm AHR based on overlay network. Under the overlay network technology, AHR adequately takes the routing information of network layer as a kind of support, using global index function of overlay layer coordinately. It not only quickly guides the packet to reach destination, but avoids expensive cost of flooding route discovery and effectively reduces the route maintenance overhead. The algorithm is analyzed and proved to have better performance through experiments.

articleTitle: Traffic Classification Using Compact Protocol Fingerprint
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Traffic classification using statistical characteristics (or fingerprints) of IP flows such as packet size and packet inter-arrival time has showed its preliminary success in sense of accuracy and simplicity. However, the need of large memory to store the fingerprints makes it impractical to deploy such method on backbone networks where a high-speed memory is needed to catch up with the high packet rate, and a large high-speed memory is always expensive. In this paper we apply the Distributional Clustering (DC) algorithm proposed by the pattern recognition community to compress the protocol fingerprints. We also presented a new algorithm named Distributional Quantification (DQ) that has lower overhead than DC. We evaluated the accuracy of classification using compact protocol fingerprints under various compression ratios through experiments. Our results show that DC outperforms DQ in terms of classification accuracy. The experimental results indicate that a compression ratio of 9 can be achieved with no more than 10% loss in classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Induction Motor Based on Artificial Immune System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on principles of artificial immune systems, this paper put forward a fault diagnosis method for induction motor. Compared to the traditional negative selection algorithm, this method is added dynamic detector radius variation and immune memory cells, and improved the fault diagnosis detection rate for induction motor. Through simulation and testing, the validity of this method is proved.

articleTitle: Design of Data Analysis Model for the Computer Auditing of the Department Budget Implementation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the development of science and technology, computerized accounting and electronic books have replaced traditional books and vouchers. Traditional manual auditing has not been able to adapt to the development of information technology because of the complex electronic data in books to be audited. And computer auditing focuses on model constructing and analyzing from the macro and micro perspective, in order to analyze the audit data effectively and rationally.

articleTitle: Data Fusion Method of Multi-dimension Oil Monitoring Based on Principal Components Analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper realizes the fusion of multi-dimension oil monitoring data by the way of principal components analysis, gets the trend curve representing the degree of wear about the equipments, keep the wear information contained in the monitoring sample to a maximum limit, which is very important to the forecast and support of equipment technology condition.

articleTitle: Research on Monitor Position in Network Situation Assessment
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: When people perform network situation assessment, they set network monitor on every node in the network. However, this method wastes a lot of resource. There is no need to monitor every node in the network. In fact, only a few nodes are enough. This paper gives a method to choose suitable nodes in the network to perform situation assessment. These nodes can cover necessary edges in the network graph. We also perform some evaluations and the results show that our methods are effective in network situation assessment.

articleTitle: Load Identification Method for a Complex Structure with Nonlinearity
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A combined iteration method of load identification method is presented concerning one type of structure with nonlinearity. The proposed method realizes the load identification of the nonlinear dynamical system by combining and iterating the finite element method and the active control method. For a conical shell-belting combined system, the numerical study regarding the load identification demonstrates the validity of combined iteration method, which can plays a guiding role in the load identification of vibration test respecting aerospace structures, such as missile, aero spacecraft, aerospace plane, rocket and so on, making great contribution to the development of the aerospace industry.

articleTitle: Dynamic Analysis on a Feeding and Unloading Manipulator Using Kane's Method Combined with Screw Theory
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper deals with the kinematics and dynamics of an automatic feeding and unloading manipulator for coupling processing machine. To provide a basis for the structure design and motion control, the kinematics and dynamics meets the need of manufacturing conditions and technological process in production are systematically studied. The dynamics model based on Kane's method and screw theory is established in this paper. Dynamics characteristic performances, and needed driving force of the system are obtained according to planning trajectory. The result shows this kinematics and dynamics method proposed in this paper are very useful, and provide theoretical foundation and guidance for designing feeding and unloading manipulator.

articleTitle: A Classification Model for Inventory Management of Spare Parts and its Application
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a classification model and its application for inventory management of spare parts based on T.L.Saaty's Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). A three level hierarchy has been structured In which five key criterion, including residual risk, low throughput, annual usage capacity, lead time and substitution, and four alternatives for each criterion are identified to classify spare parts as A (very important), B (important) and C (weak important). An example of classification of dry gas seal is introduced and this model has been used in the inventory management of spare parts in TAPLINE.

articleTitle: Second-order Consensus of Multi-agent System with Dynamic Network Topology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper investigates second-order leaderless and leader-following consensus in multi-agent systems with dynamic network topologies, where the communication weights are determined by the inter-agent distances. With the proposed leaderless consensus protocol, the states of all agents are ensured to agree on the state of the mass center of the system. By the leader-following consensus algorithm based on pinning control, all agents are guaranteed to asymptotically follow the virtual leader. Numerical results are given to verify the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: The Application and Research of the PAR Approach in the Short Term Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: For load sequences changes run in cycle by days, weeks, and years, and the power load data are non-stationary, the periodic autoregressive (PAR) model is used to describe the periodic variations accurately of the power load and establish a short-term forecast of the prediction model. Compared with traditional time series, it is show that this way is more effective.

articleTitle: Reliable AdaBoost Classification in Joint Feature Spaces
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Adaboost is used to select and combine weak classifiers from a very large pool of weak classifiers and it has been proven to be very successful for detecting faces. We follow the approach and applied it to detect rear views of cars. The detector was carefully examined and was expanded in a number of ways, such as feature quantization, learning algorithm in joint feature spaces. By using Adaboost in joint feature spaces, a reliable and fast classification is got. Experiment shows this classification perform good hitting rate and litter false positive rate than traditional AdaBoost algorithm.

articleTitle: Asymptotic Stability of a Parallel Maintenance System with Two Components
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we study the dynamic solution of a parallel maintenance system with two components. By analyzing the spectral distribution of the system operator, we prove that the dynamic solution converges strongly to the steady-state solution, thus we obtain the asymptotic stability of the system.

Author Keywords: Parallel maintenance system with two components

articleTitle: Design and Development of Hardware-in-Loop Simulation of Spacecraft Attitude Control System Based on Wireless Ad Hoc Networking
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Spacecraft attitude control system simulator is a laboratory system designed for developing and testing attitude control algorithm in a low-risk, low-cost environment. In this paper, the design and development of the hardware-in-loop simulation of spacecraft attitude control system is described, including hardware and software. The distinguished feature of the simulation system different from other simulators is that on-board data handling is based on wireless ad hoc network, which breaks through the traditional conception. Based on the established simulator, the paper presents some experimental results of spacecraft attitude control. The test results show that reliability and validity of the simulator, which provides a new way and a good support environment for the ground test of spacecrafts attitude control approaches.

articleTitle: A Research on Simulation and Modeling of Landscape Roads Based on Cellular Automata
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Road layout is one of the most important parts in landscape design. A good design of road layout largely enriches the experience of landscape. By learning from the research achievements of cellular automata, which is practiced in the field of traffic simulation, we have proposed cellular automata based on simulation and modeling method for constructing landscape roads. The essence of this method is to mapping the landscape roads' layout into a two-dimensional cellular space. Meanwhile, it generates 5 evolution rules to simulate the visitor's behavior according to their behavior patterns, and among which the fifth rule solves the issue of the visitors' collisions by using 'counterchange method'. The rule simplifies the calculation of the collisions as well.

articleTitle: Study and Design of Integrated Transmission Network Management System Based on CORBA and Web
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: According to the telecommunications transmission network, this paper briefly analyzes the shortcomings of current network management system and the characteristics of CORBA and web technologies. It also summarizes the advantage of CORBA and WEB technologies applied in TMN. Then, the design of integrated transmission network management system based on CORBA and Web is presented and constructed. An integrated architecture of this system includes three different but related aspects: functional architecture, physical architecture and information architecture.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of the Rolling Loop for a Gliding Missile with High Aspect Ratio Wings
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The rolling loop of a certain gliding missile with high aspect ratio wings (HARW) was designed through the introduction of the lateral overload feedback on the basis of the traditional Skid-to-Turn (STT) control mode, the equation of the centripetal force in our system was constructed, and the six degree-of-freedom (six-DOF) nonlinear mathematical simulation and semi-physical simulation were performed. The track of the rolling angle to the lateral overload was realized, the sideslip angle during turning process was decreased, and the ability resistant to rolling disturbance of HARW missile was enhanced.

articleTitle: Design of Upper Layer Authentication Protocol Supporting Trusted Network Connect
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes an upper layer authentication protocol supporting Trusted Network Connect (TNC) architecture. This protocol is related to Trusted Terminal, TNC architecture, Diameter Basic Protocol framework and IPSec protocol. And it is implemented in an environment of Linux operation system with C programming language, MYSQL database, Code Blocks and QT Creator tools. And test results show that the proposed protocol is comparatively efficient.

articleTitle: Research on Chaotic Variable Velocity Limit Particle Swarm Optimization with Modified Random Benchmark
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The standard Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO) will be easily trapped by the local optimization of the optimization problem. To overcome this shortage, the Chaotic Variable Velocity Limit Particle Swarm Optimization(CVVL-PSO) is proposed. It shrinks the velocity limitation with iteration going on. And it changes the inertia weight in the pattern of exponential decreasing. The algorithm introduces the modified tent series into the velocity updating process of particle. The modified random benchmark with random local optima and random radius is proposed. The global optimized point is generated randomly. And it is applied to compare with the classic benchmarks to testify the searching ability of several PSOs. In the numerical experiment, the results show the searching ability and wider feasibility of the CVVL-PSO.

articleTitle: UAV Flight Performance Optimization Based on Restart PRP Conjugate Gradient Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: To solve the problem that the integral termination condition of performance index function can not be fixed and to avoid settling high dimensional two-point-boundary-value model, the energy as a new integral variable instead of time variable has been introduced into the flight trajectory optimization. The trajectory optimization model established by energy-state method was transformed to a nonlinear programming problem. Restart PRP conjugate gradient method was proposed to solve the non-quadratic objective function. Finally, simulation is carried out based on an UAV model. The results show that compared with PRP method, the restart PRP method saves fuel by 6.76%, and the flight time of optimal flight vertical profile shortens 6.71%.

articleTitle: Subject-Based Learning of University Courses Website Construction
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: On the basis of university courses and collaborative learning theory subject-based learning website is put forward in thesis. The website adopts the B/S structure, conveniently to link with WAN. The structural design of the project site is the modules: Subject-based Knowledge, Collaborative learning, Learning Online Assessment, Experts Lecture and Learning Online Assessment.

articleTitle: Research of the S7-200 Based Portable Top Drive Drilling Simulator
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the constant updates of the drilling equipments, the traditional portable drilling simulator also need to be improved and updated timely to meet the skill training requirements of the drilling site operators and the technicians. On the basis of the existing portable simulator, this subject has updated the console, the hardware controller and the software system, also has complete the design of the portable drilling simulator which is smaller in volume and easy to be carried and used based on PLC. After promoting the uses in the oilfields, this simulator is proved to be functional, advanced in technology and have a broad development prospect.

articleTitle: Studying of Auto Creating Power-Lines CAD Graphics
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The basic components of the Power-Lines are analyzed and the basic parameters that are Power-Lines span, steering, angle, the pole Numbers and so on are illustrated in this paper. It is achieved that the basic method of automatic drawing Power -Lines CAD graphics with multi-tree traversal algorithm. It is very easy to data entry and date modify by using the automatic drawing method in this paper on Power-Lines.

articleTitle: The Research on Key Techniques of Computer Virus Propagation in the Theory of Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Conclusions are drawn based on the research of the complex network's features and propagation models of viruses and the contrastive study of several immune techniques commonly-used in the complex network, which are that different immune techniques should be applied in line with different networks and virus models, and that in the scale-free network, targets immune and acquaintances immune are much better than random immune, and targets immune is slightly better than acquaintances immune.

articleTitle: Research and Design on Multi-Agent-Based Information Trigger Reasoning of Smart House System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In view of the smart house system analysis and research, we propose a strong practical prototype of Multi-Agent-based Emotive Computing System (MAECS). For the different software and hardware of various equipments in the intelligence household, this paper sets the different agent, and for different groups of agent, put forward the thoughts of center control calculation and distributed cluster computing. With theoretical research on information trigger event, we add the thoughts of reasoning to the MAECS, and present the methods of High Value First (HVF). HVF method has a great advantage of trigger judgment on events by information. It can accurately deduce the upcoming events executed by the current process in all the events triggered by certain information.

articleTitle: Modeling and Controller Designing on the Large Attitude Adjusting Phase of Reusable Boosted Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: According to the characteristics of Reusable Boost Vehicle (RBV) during the large attitude adjusting phase, like strong nonlinearity, strong coupled and multi input-output, the nonlinear modeling is established (with the nonlinearity of aerodynamic coefficients varies with factors fully considered, such as Mach number, attack angle, sideslip angle and so on). A RBV flying control strategy based on neural network robust adaptive inverse is proposed. First, RBV system is completely decoupled using nonlinear dynamic inverse; secondly, the effect of model uncertainty is eliminated using robust adaptive method; finally, the feasibility and validity of the control strategy during the large attitude adjusting phase are verified with nonlinear simulation.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Navigation System Model Based on Mining Algorithm of Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In combination with the idea of CDIO, the intelligent navigation system model has been constructed based on the network teaching platform. This paper mainly uses mining Apriori algorithm of association rules to carry on the Web data mining. When students are learning independently on the network platform, different types of navigation can be provided and presented by this navigation system according to students' learning records and different types of program tastes in combination with the relevance between the new and old knowledge points uploaded by teachers so as to help students to identify the best learning route.

articleTitle: Research on the Key Technology of Full-Service Complex Content Creation Based on Digital New Media
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The integration of digital content creation is particularly urgent nowadays while the technology of digital new media is developing vigorously and the process of network convergence is accelerating greatly. Having analyzed and summarized the technology of digital product creation that is already existed, a fully new technology is raised on the full-service complex content creation. The basic idea of the technical solution and technical support is described, and the architecture of its technical and specific implementation plan is discussed. Then, how the technical solution is applied in the specific project is pointed out according to a project of new media bus. After that, the improvement of efficiency is analyzed by comparing with traditional technology. Finally, the paper summarizes the current result, and the prospect of further work.

articleTitle: Latency Analysis of Automobile ABS Based on AADL
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: ABS latency analysis is difficult issue in design phase. In this article the causes of each system delay is analysed and end to end flow delay algorithm in the worst case is used, Architecture Analysis and Design Language(AADL) is studied to model the system. End to end flow latency has been computed and compared with the expected value by AADL tool OSATE. The result shows that the analysis method can be used to resolve the flow latency bottleneck and it provides a new approach to system design and optimization.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of a Spider in Local Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the principle and method of the search engine, it also gives the design and implementation of the multi-thread concurrent spider based on the local network. This spider adopts the BloomFilter to solve the URL duplicate and thread pool to manage the concurrent threads; it uses the IoC technique in Spring to provide the support of the different file formats such as DOC, PDF, XLS etc which can demonstrate the scalability of the whole application; the spider speeds up the I/O performance by storing the data in the light database. At the end of the paper, we give the comparison and the analysis between the local search engine and general business search engine in the efficiency and performance.

articleTitle: Parallel Deviation of Concave Mirrors in Herriott Multipass Cells
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Reflection spot patterns changes has been analysed both theoreticallly and numerically based on matrix optics and combinatorics when there is some parallel deviation between the two concave mirorrs of a Herriott multipass cell. The results show that, with a fixed inlet spot location of the incident light, the reflection spots can still distribute in a same circle by adjust the incidence angle even for non-parallel mirorrs of a Herriott multipass cell. With increasing parallel deviation between the two reflection mororrs, the circle radius increases, and center of the circular path is no longer located at the center of the reflection mirorr, it is farther and farther from the center of the reflection mirorr. These characteristics help us determine whether there is parallel deviation between the two concave reflection mirorrs and to judge its relative magnitude. It can be served as a guide for optical path adjustment in Herriott multipass experiment.

articleTitle: On Acknowledgement Confirmation of Inter-Vehicle Safety Broadcasting MAC Protocols
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Inter-vehicle safety communication is a low cost method to improve road traffic safety. This paper surveys the acknowledgement confirmations in broadcasting MAC protocols and their applicability to inter-vehicle safety communication. The characteristics and the key problems of inter-vehicle safety communication are analyzed. Acknowledgement confirmation is an important factor affecting the message reception reliability and the delivery latency. Due to the different reply mechanisms, the broadcasting MAC protocols are classified, the corresponding acknowledgement confirmation and its applicability to inter-vehicle safety communication are discussed. At last, we conclude the acknowledgement confirmation of inter-vehicle safety communication.

articleTitle: A Novel Text Detection Approach Based on Multi-Structure Element of Morphology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A novel text detection method based on multi-structure elements of morphology is presented to extract text lines in this paper. Firstly, a multi-structure elements of morphology-based scheme is executed to extract contrast edges from color images. Then connected component analysis and a cascade classification scheme are adopted to obtain candidate text lines. Finally, a projection based method is applied to extract character characteristics to filter out impossible text lines. Experimental results indicate that the proposed method can effectively detect text lines in different font-size, language and background complexity.

articleTitle: E-Government Safety Management Based on Data Encrypt
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Currently, electronic government has developed rapidly because it can not only greatly improve the efficiency of government but can also provide satisfactory service to citizens. However, there are various inherent risks in electronic government. One of the most significant risks is data safety. The general principle for constructing safe electronic government is put forward. And a model of E-Government management based on data encrypt is built, in which, data encrypt identity is used to check the technique password. It proved that the method can help E-Government to realize the data safety.

articleTitle: The Repetition Rate of AO-Cr4+:Nd:YAG Doubly Q-switched Laser
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the repetition rate stability of Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG passively Q-switched lasers, the saturable absorption characteristics of Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG crystal has been studied. A laser diode pumped AO-Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG doubly Q-switched laser is realized. It was found that, tuned the repetition rate of AO Q-switch, the pulse repetition rate would be locked by the AO Q-switch, which was equal to the repetition rate of AO Q-switch or halfway. This put forward a method to improve the repetition rate stability of single passively Q-switched lasers.

articleTitle: Optical Signal Noise Ratio Increased by Multiplexing Algorithm for QSFP+ Module
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In order to increase OSNR (Optical Signal Noise Ratio, OSNR) of QSFP+ module, a multiplexing algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the development of optical module and the characteristics of QSFP+ module are illustrated; Secondly, the realization steps of the multiplexing algorithm is provided; Thirdly, this algorithm is applied in QSFP+ module and the corresponding circuit of host board is designed and the experimental result shows that multiplexing algorithm is able to increase OSNR 2 dB.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of P2p Value-Added Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Nowadays, people on the use of the growing demand for wireless Internet access, Peer to peer (P2P) technology scene is gradually shifting from the traditional wired P2P network to mobile P2P network.
