When the mobile terminals in the mobile P2P networks request the media data, the system only contains the media data of all mobile terminals of the node list or provides only a list of non-mobile terminal nodes. It is not based on the processing ability of these mobile device media to distinguish and screen out. The server system and management approach are not conducive to the effective use of media resources. In order to overcome the problems of existing technologies, a region management server system and scheduling method based on P2P is proposed. This method can manage media resources reasonably and filter nodes effectively according to the media processing ability of mobile P2P network nodes.

articleTitle: An Efficient Mapping Scheme for Shingled Recording Hard Drives
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The computer science and industry improves a lot these years, the storage architecture has been changed lots. Solid state drives have been introduced years, but the price of the flash memory doesn't decrease, though its technology increase a lot. When talks to magnetic hard drives, the density and capacity are always the hot research areas since there have more difficulties on improving disk performance. A novel recording technology called shingled recording was presented to improve the magnetic density, however, the random write problem has been plaguing its application. This paper will introduce an efficient translation scheme for shingled recording hard drives to shield random write flaw. We divide the shingled disk space into many partitions, base on the regions, and adapt a special mapping method. Our simulator results have shown that this translation scheme improves performance about 30%~40% of random write comparing with Hitachi log system.

articleTitle: Wcet Predictable Exception Mechanism for Real-Time Java Platform
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the effects of the time indeterminacy which was caused by the exception thrown and handled of the JVM on the real-time Java platform, the Class Convertor generates an image file in which the exception table is stored in like-linear structure, and which give the class index and superclass index of an exception object directly. When an exception is thrown, exception tables are traversed in linear order to find the match item and get the pointer value where the program will jump to continue. The match time presents a linear change according to the number of exception tables and can be predicted with the number and the location where the match item is in the structure.

articleTitle: A General Way to Break Hash-based Challenge-and-Response
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Hash-based challenge-and-response protocols are widely used as an authentication scheme in network applications. The authenticator sends a random string as a challenge to the peer, the peer generates a response with a hash function on a pre-shared password combined the received challenge. In this paper, we propose a general and efficient way to break some prevalent hash-based challenge- and-response protocols in use. These protocols are vulnerable to the chosen challenge attack launched by a malicious user, who impersonates the server. We first generate a rainbow table containing hash values of all possible passwords, which is produced by hashing a pre-chosen challenge concatenated with all possible password candidates. Second, we impersonate the authenticator and send the pre-chosen challenge to the peer. Finally, we look up in the rainbow table for the received response from the peer to crack the password. With this tactic, we can do the cost consuming pre-computation once, and then we can always use it to recover all of the peer's passwords with only one additional on-line query.

articleTitle: Panoramic Orientation Design and Implement Based on Open Source Software PTViewer
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Panoramic images to simulate two-dimensional of the real three-dimensional space, presented to the viewer. And to provide all kinds of manipulation of the image viewer function, you can zoom in and out, watching the scene in all direction to simulate and reproduce the scenes to achieve the real effect of the environment. Image Map (pohotographic map) is a map with ground-sensing image, which is based on aviation and space-based remote sensing image, the geometric correction, in line with the line work and a little note, the graphics object that the surface of the integrated Maps, is the use of aerial photographs or satellite imagery, through the geometric correction, projection transformation and the scale reduction, the use of certain map symbols, annotation, drawing objects directly reflect the spatial distribution of geographic features and map. Image Map is a video content, the line designated elements, mathematical foundation, contour decoration of the map. PTViewer is an open source Java project, which could control in real time to read the perspective of the current roaming and other information, but the panoramic view of the level of the angle 0 ¡ã is not roaming the map corresponds to the direction of the north. Therefore, the paper puts forward a kind of orientation to determine the true panoramic roaming the corresponding direction based on open source software PTViewer. The experiment showed that the panoramic orientation is much valid, which could link these two types of data, and something useful is obtained.

articleTitle: The Design of Emergency Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In order to develop a high degree of software reuse, system architecture flexibility, we studied the emergency decision support system which will be quickly to be changed. Based on the domain engineering method, the knowledge of UML modeling, and feature-oriented domain analysis technology, the component development method of emergency decision support system is presented. We have been building a vertical cross-section cutting, component knit, hierarchical design of the component model. Component model can be combined according to user needs to improve the efficiency of such system development and quality.

articleTitle: The Newton-Kantorovich Convergence Theoremf or a Deformed Newton Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this study, we establish the Newton-Kantorovich convergence theorem with three orders for a deformed Newton methods in Banach space by using two orders majorizing function, which is used to solve the nonlinear operator equation. We also present the error estimate. Finally, the examples are provided to show the application of our theorem.

articleTitle: Order of Convergence Based on Discrepancy Principle for the Dynamical Systems Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper investigates the order of convergence based on discrepancy principle for the dynamical systems method. Firstly, proposing the dynamical systems method, we estimate the order of convergence of solution based on discrepancy principle. Then, we prove order of convergence.

articleTitle: Semantic Unit Based Question Representation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Question representation is a fundamental task in Question Answering (QA) system. An approach based on semantic unit (SU) is proposed, which selects the domain words and phrases as semantic components, and organize them together to form SU instances according their relationships in domain ontology. The question is represented by the vector of SU instances. With the supports of shallow semantic analysis and domain ontology, SUs instances are easily constructed and extracted using some simple rules. In a QA system of computer fault diagnoses restricted domain, the proposed method has been employed and implemented. Experimental results have shown its efficiency and contributions to the improvement of overall performance of QA.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulating of Airflow around Metro Train Head
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The aerodynamic model of flow around metro train is built in this paper. The distributing of air flow around metro train head is calculated and analyzed based on aerodynamics of train and CFX. According to the result, the difference of the distributing of flow outfield and pressure field among these models are analyzed and compared. The proper parameters of contour design of streamlined train head were achieved. They provide theoretical foundation for the development of metro train contour design.

articleTitle: Development of 3GHz Analog Fiber Optic Link for Ultra-fast Signal Transmission
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A broad bandwidth analog fiber optic link is developed for ultra-fast signal transmission under the circumstance with complicated electromagnetic fields. The electrical ultra-fast signal is converted to optical ones by electro-optic conversion method which operates via amplitude modulation mechanism. With several kilometers distance transmission, the optical signal is recovered by photo-electric conversion method correspondingly. The measurement results of the link indicate that its bandwidth is (0.0003-3)GHz, in-band flatness ±1dB, linear dynamic range 40dB, output peak-to-peak noise within 5mV, both of input and output standing-wave-ratios less than 2. It's applied in high power microwave experiments. The experimental results show that the 3GHz analog fiber optic link which employs electro-optic and photo-electric conversion techniques is suitable for ultra-fast pulse signals transmission. It greatly improves the bandwidth margin of the diagnosis system.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Diode Pumped Double Q-switched Nd3+:YAG Laser
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Double Q-switched Laser is realized using LD End-pumped Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>:YAG crystal, AO modulator and Cr<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4+</sup>:YAG saturable absorber. The repetition frequency, average output power and pulse width of the laser pulses were investigated experimentally. When the double Q-switched laser works at a stable repetition frequency, in comparison with the single Q-switched case, it is found that the pumped threshold electric current is a little higher, whereas the average output power is lower, the pulse width is narrower and the compression of the pulse width occurs mainly at the fall-edge time. Hence, double Q-switch is advantageous to improve the symmetry of the laser pulse output.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Search Model and an Improved Matching Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With development of semantic web technology, the intelligent and semantic exploration is becoming an important discussion to the research of search engine. This paper proposes a model of semantic search engine based on analysis of Semantic Web and ontology, and considering inheritance relationship between nodes, improves the concept of semantic distance and similarity matching algorithm. The results show that these optimizations improve the accuracy and expand the scope of application.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Influencing of the Packet Size to the Available Bandwidth Measurement Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The paper analyzed the network model and calculation method which is used to measure the available bandwidth. It constructed virtual IP network environment and chose the typical tools to repeat the experiment. In the package transmission, the paper found out the best size of package in manual intervention and concluded the more reasonable measurement method in the different network environment.

articleTitle: Mass Storage System Construction Method in a High Performance Computing Center
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Mass Storage is a new research hotspot of Information Technology fields. In this paper, we carry out research in a high performance computing centre, whose mass storage system was expanded and reconstructed. We introduce the key technology of storage system, and make discuss of the using method and management method in heterogeneous mass storage system. We've focused on analyzing and introducing the space management, data migration, hierarchical storage and quota administration in a mass storage system. On that basis, we construct a mass storage system of a high performance computing centre.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Spatial Analysis of MapInfo-based Underground Pipe Net
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: According to the present management and construction of city pipe net, this paper analyzed spatial functions of underground city pipe net in Anshan City, and proposed detailed design and steps. The work in this paper is effective to the burst analysis and fracture. The practical application shows its value in the management of the city pipe net.

articleTitle: The Design of the Front-End for DMB-TH
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper proposed a scheme of direct down-conversion which realize a radio frequency (RF) front end of Zero-IF receiver based on DMB-TH (Digital Multimedia Broadcast-Terrestrial/ Handheld). It was materialized by FC2558 tuner IC and EPM570 controller. Besides, tests and analysis about the filter and the automatic gain controller (AGC) of this system are illustrated in detail. The system shows excellent performance on anti-interferences and has several features including simple circuit structure, low power consumption, low noise figure and wide input dynamic range.

articleTitle: An Application Research of Aspect-Oriented Technology in Embedded Software
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on research of Aspect-Oriented Technology and Embedded Software, software developments for embedded systems are provided with a visual process and platform from analysis, designing, coding and testing. The control software development for Automatic Beverage Machine, an example of using Aspect-Oriented Technology in Embedded Software, is proved as an effective way to develop both control technology and software.

articleTitle: A Fast Target Recognition Algorithm Based on MSA and MSR
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new fast target recognition algorithm, the proposed method is based on Multi-scale Auto convolution(MSA) and Multi-scale Retinex(MSR). As shown by the comparison with original MSA, it appears that this new technique solves the problem that MSA algorithm is sensitive to illumination and the computational load is significantly reduced to 1/8th of that of the original MSA algorithm, it is also robust to affine transform, light projective transform, noise, thin fog, occlusion and illumination change. the performed experiments show that it has fast searching speed, and can accurately recognize and locate target in real scenes.

articleTitle: Typology of Liability of Network Infringement
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: There are many and different patterns of network violation problems happened in our real-life, but "Tort Liability Law of People's Republic of China" only adopted one provision to regulate the network infringement, so there are a lot of specific operational problems in the law. This paper is to type variety of network infringement and tort liability by using the standard of the type of network tort main body. Different tort liability will be applied to different infringement liability arising from different network tort main body in order to better solve real problems in the network infringement.

Author Keywords: typology of liability of network infringement

articleTitle: Investigation of Robust Digital Watermarking Based on Multi-Level DCT
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Because of possible wide spread utilization of watermarking techniques, the techniques itself and its resistance to filtering and geometrical attacks have been researched widely. But, few papers discuss the anti-noise performance of watermarking techniques. A new watermarking method based on multi-level Discrete Cosine Transform (MDCT) is proposed in this paper. The Lena image added different level noise is used as experimental object. The experimental results show that this method can provides much better performance of anti-noise than the method based on DCT, as may the property of centralizing energy of DCT is fully exploited.

articleTitle: Preventing Location-based Inference Attack in Location Based Services
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The query privacy issue in location-based services (LBS) has recently received considerable attention. To protect the query privacy of users, current state-of-the-art techniques adopt cloaking which cloaks the sender's location to k-anonymized spatial region (ASR), such that an attack based on the sender's location cannot identify the query source with probability larger than 1/k, among other k-1 users. However, these techniques do not consider that these k-1 additional mobile users with different privacy requirements may send request at the same time. In this paper, we propose a new attack model that an adversary who observes all the ASRs at one time can identify the query source with probability larger than 1/k based on prior knowledge of the locations of all users. And we propose our two algorithms, namely, Basic and Adaptive Algorithms, which strengthen the privacy guarantee to defend such inference attack while still support personalized user privacy requirements. We verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithms by experiments on location data which synthetically generated on real road maps.

articleTitle: SAR Image Speckle Reduction Based on Lifting Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A new method for SAR images speckle reduction based on lifting wavelet transform is proposed. To evaluate the performance of this filter, the adaptive local statistics filters, which include Lee filter, Kuan filter, Frost filter and a wavelet-based soft-thresholding filter are applied to the speckle reduction for a same SAR image. The performances are compared in several aspects including mean, standard deviation and Equivalent Number of Looks. The results show that the algorithm presented in this paper performs better in restraining noise and remaining the edges and textures of image than the conventional filters do.

articleTitle: CSMA-BT Protocol for Intra-Flight Data Link
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The intra-flight data link is a new dedicated tactical data link used in the aircraft formation to transmit tactical information. A multiple access protocol for intra-flight data link called CSMA-BT (Carrier Sense Multiple Access based on Busy Tone) is proposed in this paper. By analyzing time delay performance of CSMA-BT protocol, the results show that CSMA-BT can meet combat requirement of intra-flight data transmission well.

articleTitle: Implementation of Emergency Management System Based on Distributed Solving Process
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In order to eliminate information silos in emergency management, and to achieve information sharing and data exchange, this paper gives the Emergency Management System framework from the aspect of knowledge, professional, versatility and flexibility. Then Emergency Management System implementation plan based on distributed solving process is provided, which provides support for science and high reliability emergency management, and provides good theoretical support for building a cloud computing platform in emergency management area.

articleTitle: The Network Model of Server-Vertex Multimedia Service Quality
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: As you know, service quality is a comprehensive annotation to test the satisfaction of a service, or quality of service. The paper introduces the service quality technical model and the web site client multimedia Service Quality. Then we can help you establish a complete information model of service quality.

articleTitle: Development of Electronic Engine Virtual Detection System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With different characters of electronic signals, clearly displaying all kinds of signals can provide important information for maintenance men and college teachers. Development of the virtual instrument on engine signals detection, which both can achieve the function of gathering and can storage, playback and put out the waveform by two displaying grams - recorder and oscilloscope, make the procedure replace traditional instrument. Additionally, it's easy to update the system and share data. The solution is well verified by experiments and will bring the convenience for vehicle's future network age.

articleTitle: Application Research for Observer Pattern in .NET Framework
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Observer pattern is a widely used design pattern. In the process of programming much work need be done. the delegate and event technology of .NET framework can effectively reduce the coupling of the code, reduce error rate so that implementing of the pattern is more concise, and it has a better scalability.

articleTitle: Research on the Image Query System Based on Relation Database
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Image database technology is based on relation database. It requires entrying the image or hotspot query and analyzing the structure of image database. This paper research on how to design resonable image database and image hotspot processing, using expansion database schema and image processing technology such as BLOB. It's a formidable task to achieve image hotspot query through large image database. The result shows that image query system can effectively solve the problems like image entrying, retrieval and hotspots processing.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Dimming Power System for LED Desk Lamp
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The LED illuminating technique is a hotspot of present research and industry application. Aiming at a practical application, this paper designs a driving power system for a LED desk lamp which has a metal cover. The metal cover can be touched by human body to intelligently dim the LED lights in multi-levels. According to the testing experiments, this system works well.

articleTitle: The Application Research on Graphic Traverse Algorithm in Graphic Topology Analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Graph depth-first traverse algorithm is based on the premise of establishing an adjacency table. According to the demand of graphic component auto-creating in monitoring system, this paper acts in a diametrically opposite way, improves graphic traverse algorithm which creates the adjacency table, and puts forward a kind of algorithm which completes graphic topology analysis with database. The algorithm automatically analyzes system graph of electric substation, traverses every equipment and line, generates the adjacency table, and sets up relationship of equipments. The key of the algorithm is how to accurately determine whether the equipment is connected or not. The application of the algorithm on electric substation automation system is satisfactory. The program using Delphi 6.0 is successfully tested in Windows 98/XP/2000.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of Embedded Video Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In intelligent traffic system, we not only need to get the corresponding traffic condition by image processing, but also need to illustrate the information and vehicles changes detected through the characters and graphics changes, thus to get traffic information visualization. A video monitoring and control system are designed in this paper based on DSP and FPGA. The system can realize the real-time traffic video data acquisition, DSP processors complete traffic information parameters extraction, FPGA complete the video overlap of traffic information parameters. This method realize the Dynamic video monitoring and controlling, is well applied in the intelligent traffic system.

articleTitle: Sensitive Information Acquisition Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of Internet, online information has greatly enriched. The Internet becomes a vast treasure of information, but simultaneously it is also flooding various trash information, such as: viruses, Trojans, violence, pornography, gambling and so on. The hostile forces outside of country and criminal elements are using the Internet to engage in illegal activities that endanger national security. So how to recognize this information to find the corresponding website and to carry on the effective supervision has become an urgent problem. For these reasons, this paper designs a new web information extraction system, which calls the extraction rule corresponding to the template by calculating the structural similarity among pages. In addition, a new method based on STU-DOM tree to construct decision tree is proposed. This method can use the classification of decision tree to determine sensitive information node.

articleTitle: Design of Construction Project Drawing Censoring Information System Based on UML
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In order to better the censoring of construction drawings, we research the process of censoring drawings from the point of information management system. Based on the UML modeling technology, we design models for each procedure of censoring drawings such as reception, distribution, censoring, reply, charging, approval, certification and inquiring. Through using case diagram, activity diagram, sequence diagram, class collaboration and relationship diagram, we discuss the process and methods of modeling based on UML, and implement the system by using .NET technology. Application of this system can normalize the censoring process, enhance the management level and work efficiency.

articleTitle: Quantum Secure Direct Communication Protocol Based on Entangled State and Quantum State
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In the paper, a protocol of quantum secure direct communication (QSDC) based on EPR entangled state and a quantum state of one particle is presented. The proposed protocol of QSDC uses the idea of one time pad of classical cryptology. The concept of data block and the method of split-step transmission are introduced into the proposed protocol of QSDC. According to the property of quantum, the eavesdropper can get nothing from quantum communication system, so the security of whole QSDC system is ensured. A part of secret message which will be transmitted is loaded on entangled states by processing quantum dense encoding operation on entangled particles. A nonorthogonal mixed state of single particle is introduced into the proposed protocol in order to improve the transmission efficiency, hence another part of secret message which will be transmitted is loaded on states of single particle. The private key and secret message are transmitted directly at the same time on quantum channel. So the proposed scheme of QSDC shall gain higher efficiency as well as complexity increase, and the system be proved the security by performance analysis.

articleTitle: Quantum Clock Synchronization in Noisy Channel
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Previous researches show that the quantum clock synchronization can achieve a high accuracy in noise-free channel. However, there is much noise in actual channel. The noise may introduce some errors during synchronization. The paper study the accuracy in two noisy channels: Bit flip channel and Phase flip channel. We find the pollution channel may usually degrade time accuracy. And the accuracy of Phase flip may be worse than accuracy of Bit flip. In some pollution case, quantum clock synchronization does not provide any valuable time information.

articleTitle: Data Acquisition Circuit of the Energy-saving Controller in Classroom
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The Energy-saving controller can control the light intelligently by recognizing and judging the existence of the human body and ambient light, and avoid wasting a lot of electricity. Classroom environment light and the present or not the body are two important input parameters of the energy-saving controller. This paper designs two circuits which are light signal acquisition circuit and human existence optical sampling circuit. And the software program of the data acquisition circuits, also point out the specific requirements to the sensor's installation.

articleTitle: TDD WMNs Experimental Prototype Equipment and Experimental Platform Based on Cross-layer Design
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: WMNs have many advantages such as wide coverage, high reliability, self-configuring, self-healing, high efficiency, etc. It is more suitable for covering large open areas than the traditional 'last mile' access technology. WMNs can be divided into asynchronous WMNs and synchronous WMNs (TDD WMNs or TDMA WMNs) according to synchronization way. Compared with the asynchronous WMNs, TDD WMNs have the advantages of small collision rate, better to solve the hidden terminal and exposure terminal, high resource utilization. Currently the research and exploration space of TDD product is so large that we developed a TDD WMNs experimental prototype equipment and experimental platform to lay the foundation for future research and development.

articleTitle: A Study on the Basic Principles of Setting up Materiel Code System in ERP
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on the ERP system implementation process, the heavy data preparation work load, many participators in the personnel, complex work content, difficulty in control and other characteristics, this article proposed the principles, requests and specification of the setting up material code system, introducing the Xianyang petroleum steel pipe steel cable Limited liability company's CIMS project as the case to exemplify.

articleTitle: Track and Track Association Based on Multiple Fusion Center
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on the multi-sensor and multi-target tracking, a system structure with Multiple Fusion Center (MFC) is designed. Furthermore, Track and Track Association (TTA) algorithm which fuses the track of each Fusion Center (FC) is analyzed.

articleTitle: Submerged Objects Detecting in the Focusing Regime of Stimulated Brillouin Scattering
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A method to detecting Submerged Objects by using the effective interaction length of Stimulated Brillouin Scattering (SBS) in the focusing regime is presented in this paper. Relationship of reflected energy dependent on the location of the object in Stimulated Brillouin Scattering cell is introduced, which is used to give the location of Stokes signal disappearing theoretically. We experimentally study Submerged Objects detecting measurements when the detected object is present in three different place, i.e., in front of the focus, just in the place of the focus and the behind of the focus. The delay time of the echo signal to pump signal can give the location of Submerged Object. Using input laser with 532nm nanosecond pulse generated by Q-switched Nd:YAG laser, experimental results show when object is placed in front of focus the measurement error is the lest and the error was less than 4% within 188cm water cell.

articleTitle: A High-Accuracy Design of Frequency Divider with FPGA and ASIC Implementation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a new algorithm to realize the decimal frequency divider with any number divide ratio. In the statistical periods, the divide ratio is adjusted dynamically by calculating the error of clock. Error of divider can be reduced, and the accuracy has come to 2.3E-11% after 4 rounds. The implementation of decimal frequency divider was realized with FPGA and ASIC. The article analyzed the resource and performance and compared the result of 180nm and 90nm technology on the ASIC. The layout of the circuit was realized on 180nm technology. The experimental result indicated that the decimal frequency divider takes fewer resources, and its performance is steady and reliable.

articleTitle: A Visualization Simulation Method of Complex Weapon System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In order to solve difficult problem on simulation of complex weapon system, a visualization simulation method aim at complex weapon engineering is put forward based on United Modeling Language(UML) modeling description. It describes the implementation process in detail, including the effective management of structural relationship between simulation models, organization of models and maintenance & modification of simulation. Its results show that this method not only supports the software models in whole process of software development starting from demand analysis, but also supports the non-software system description such as weapon equipment engineering. The visualization simulation method can effectively solve complex problem of simulation development and its difficult maintenance, and can improve the actual work efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on FOG Random Errors Modeling Based on AFSA
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Fiber-optic gyroscope random drift is not only the main errors influence gyroscope accuracy, but also the main factors influence Gyro's performance reliability. It has a very important significance that using the time series analysis method, modeling random excursions of gyroscope, analyzes the main reasons causing gyroscope excursion withing historical data. Gyro model, usually by the ARMA(n, m) stochastic model, but the traditional ARMA model establishment method is relatively complicated. And parameter estimation algorithm based on AFSA can overcome ARMA model complexity. This paper models the random errors of Gyro used AFSA firstly, and gets good results, provides a new idea and method for time series analysis.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Framework of Mobile Business Systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The popularity of wireless network technology made the web-business leap a phenomenal progress and transform to mobile business. But traditional mobile business systems have revealed its deficiencies. This paper introduces the status mobile network and puts forward a new handling process that can be summarized as what was "obtaining source code, normalizing source code---selecting necessary code---showing on the mobile terminal" according to the deficiencies. Compared with the traditional develop mode, this article proposes an intelligent framework which includes three framework layers, four function platforms, and forms a powerful, real-time mobile web portal platform.

articleTitle: Vibration Signal Analysis of Vehicle in Highway Based on AR Model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The AR model method was proposed in the analysis of information extraction of vehicle sound signals in highway traffic flow. Based on the appropriate selection of AR model order and sample data, the feature vectors were used to distinguish different vehicle models. Through parameter model theory, we proposed feature method in vehicle signal recognition technology to achieve the requirement of auxiliary determination. This paper has demonstrated that the feasibility of model identification and feature extraction using the highway vehicle audio signal. The result showed that AR model is an effective way in vehicle type classification.

articleTitle: Existence of Solutions for Fractional Differential Equations Boundary Value Problem with Delay
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we study a class of fractional functional differential equation with delay. We use Green function to reformulate the boundary value problem into an abstract operator equation. The existence of positive solutions of the boundary value problem for this class of fractional functional differential equation is obtained by using fixed point theorems on cone.

articleTitle: Analysis of Terahertz Absorption Spectra Characteristic of 1-Naphthaleneacetic Acid and 4-Chlorophenoxyacetic Acid in Terahertz Region
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: We firstly study terahertz time-domain spectroscopy (THz-TDS) characterization of two kinds of pesticides 1-naphthaleneacetic acid and 4-chlorophenoxyacetic acid. The absorption spectrum and refractive index of samples were measured. Theoretical investigation of the vibrational spectrum of pesticides was performed based on density function theory (DFT). We observed that experiment spectra are in rough qualitative agreement with these theory spectra. Its chemical composition was successfully identified through spectral analysis of the recorded terahertz waveform. These feature spectra measurements are helpful to form a database of pesticide.

articleTitle: Challenge-Response Attack on a Key Transport Protocol based on a Ring Locking Technique
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Key transport is one of the fundamental issues in modern cryptography. Recently Khayat proposed a multiple agent distributed version of Shamir's 3-pass no-key protocol. In this paper, based on a ring locking technique a challenge-response attack on Khayat's protocol is mounted to capture its vulnerability to CCA1 and CCA2. The cryptanalysis shows that the attack protocol is efficient (without expensive on-line computation of modular inverses), scalable (independent of the size of trustees), and feasible on the Internet environment. One of its novel features is that the active attacker can conceal some trace of his cyber crime by means of the commutative property of index multiplication in iterative modular exponentiations.

articleTitle: An Approximation Method of Positive Semi-definite Matrix Based on Weighted F-norm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Positive is the important hypotheses of many financial forecasting models, but the correlation coefficient matrix we get from actual samples are not always positive. Firstly, we introduced how to set correlation coefficient matrix according to the sample, and introduced the theory of norm approximation, based on which we find the proximal correlation coefficient matrix, namely unit diagonal positive semi-definite symmetric matrix. Finally, the validity of method in this paper has been proved in practical experiment.

articleTitle: Study of the Scheduling Rules of Short-term Power Generation Dispatching for Single Hydropower Station
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Short-term optimal operation of hydropower station is a high-dimensional, multi-constraint and complex system problem. In this paper, Liyuan hydropower station located in the middle reaches of Jinsha River is cited as an example, and the mathematical model of optimal power generation dispatching has been established. We obtain a large amount of optimal scheduling processes by using the progressive optimality algorithm (POA). Then, the corresponding scheduling rules for single hydropower station which can take advantage of runoff prediction results are derived. A case indicates that the scheduling rules can be effectively used to guide the actual operation run of Liyuan hydropower station.

articleTitle: ADBUDG Model Optimization and Practical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: If want to keep a market place for their products in an increasingly competitive circumstance, the best way is advertising. Thus, the scientific advertising budget strategic for advertising operation is very valuable and significant. In this paper, the original ADBUDG model is improved by the introduction of two parameters: media efficiency index and ad copy effectiveness index. Using MKENG software to operate the model and analysis, we can find the new model advantages.

articleTitle: The Research about Coal Price Risk Management Based on Option
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The coal price risk to the coal enterprise and the downstream Enterprise's production operation was a very important question, this article utilized the option theory to conduct the research to the coal price risk management, proposed that developing the coal option might dodge the coal price risk which brought for the coal enterprise and the downstream Enterprise, it was helpful in correcting the market control action, realized the economical steady movement.

articleTitle: An Algorithm of SelectING Input Measurement Fusion
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: For measurement fusion of a linear time-invariant system, in past literatures, it's impliedly consented that all the input measurements will contribute to enhance the fusion precision. In the suspicion of this hypothesis, this paper analysis the fusion principle based on kalman filtering framework and discusses the impact of quantity and quality of the input measurements on fusion accuracy. Based on the conclusion, a new fusion method called selecting input measurement fusion (SIMF) is proposed. The procedure of SIMF is divided into two steps. First, select input measurements by calculating estimated error of each input measurement and selecting smaller ones compared with a threshold. Second, fuse as usual. Theoretical analysis and computer simulation shows that SIMF can effectively improve the accuracy compared with the original algorithm.

articleTitle: Strategy Research on E-Business for Small and Medium Sized Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the global economy integration, enterprises must face the impact from the E-business. As a new business model and enterprise operation, The E-business plays an important role in operation, competition, supply chain and development of the enterprises. After analyzing the advantages of the third-party E-business platform, the Paper puts forward the strategy on developing the E-business of the small and medium sized enterprises based on the current situation of small size, poor capital and backward development of the small and medium sized enterprises. It will affect the development of the small and medium sized enterprises and sustainable, healthy and stable development of Chinese economy.

articleTitle: A Semantic Annotation Method for Network Image
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a semantic annotation method of network image, by calculating the semantic weight of different types of relevant texts, and the bi-structure information between related texts. Our experiments show that this method is effective.

articleTitle: The Green Supply Chain Evaluation and Construction of a Coal Chemical Enterprise in Hebei Province which Based on Fuzzy-AHP Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Chemical enterprise not only consumes huge resources, but also the person who gives the huge pollution to the environment. So, building and implementing green supply chain management has practical value to promote the sustainable development of coal industry, it can play a positive role in promoting social economy's development rapidly and healthily, too. In this article, after an analysis of the existing problems in the green supply chain management of coal chemical enterprise, we try to use Fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (Fuzzy-AHP) to quantitative the influence degree, and then, we design a construction scheme about the green supply chain management of a chemical enterprise.

articleTitle: Study on Topology of the Set of Equilibrium Points of Longitudinal Dynamics of Hypersonic Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper describes the topology of equilibrium points of longitudinal dynamics of hypersonic vehicles using numerical analysis method based on the model developed by Bolender and Doman. First, the set of equilibrium points of longitudinal dynamics in cruise condition is obtained under reasonable flight constraint and flight envelope expressed by flight velocity and altitude is approximately estimated. Second, the relationships of the angle of attack, elevator deflection and equivalence ratio to velocity and altitude are studied and three block diagrams for the three relationships are plotted respectively.

articleTitle: A New Method for Shot Boundary Detection
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A effective algorithm for shot boundary detection in compressed domain is proposed in this paper. Firstly, only I frames are uncompressed partly to generate DC images and then character of these DC images to be extracted. Secondly, for cut detection, shot boundary is generally detected by difference of DC images' character and then precisely located by movement information of B frames in compressed video. For gradual transition detection, the range of shot gradual transition is generally detected by CDDC algorithms presented in this paper and then precisely located by the change of amount of intra coding macroblocks in P frames. By this way, the disadvantage of shot boundary detection in compressed domain is compensated. So the algorithm presented in this paper has merit of good efficiency and good precision.

articleTitle: The Design of Data Acquisition System Based on CAN Bus in Ocean Observatory
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: CAN bus communication network have the advantage of high-speed communication, high reliability and long-distance transmission in ocean observatory. One kind of data acquisition system based on CAN bus is designed in this paper. The system is designed using C8051F040 as microcontroller. The hardware block diagram is described in detail. The modular software flow charts of data acquisition, communication initialization, data transmission and data reception is given. The realization of the design method is simple, reliable, easy to node expansion, and the performance is stable after test in lab. It requires test in the marine environment.

articleTitle: Electronic Voting: A Review and Taxonomy
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Electronic voting has the potential to be the most reliable, secure and trustworthy voting approach. Digital technology including error correction, robust storage and cryptographic security offers the possibility to record, transmit, store and count votes far more reliably than paper. This research area has been quite productive, with numerous directions explored and fascinating techniques developed. In this paper, we review the researches on the electronic voting schemes toward trustworthy voting system and discuss the issues about several important properties and challenges.

articleTitle: Phase Synchrony Measurement of ERP Based on Complex Wavelet During Visual-Audio Multisensory Integration
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we employ the measurement of phase synchrony to investigate the activities of multisensory integration during cognitive process. This approach is illustrated by exploiting a complex Morlet wavelet to quantify the frequency-specific synchronization (i.e., transient phase-locking value, PLV) between two neuroelectric signals at a predefined frequency range. The motivation for its development is to be able to investigate the role of neural synchronies as a putative mechanism for neural integration during cognitive tasks. Unlike the more traditional method of spectral coherence, PLV separates the phase and amplitude components and can be directly interpreted in the framework of neural integration. We apply PLV to investigate electrode recordings from subjects performing a visual and auditory discrimination task. We find different synchronies in brain regions between unisensory and multisensory stimuli conditions. We argue that phase synchrony effects do reflect cognitive processing. Obtaining results indicate a possible relevance of this method based on Morlet wavelet in the context of cognitive science as well as in other fields.

articleTitle: Asymmetric-Aware Scheduling for Single-ISA Asymmetric CMP Using Offline Analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Previous work has already testified from both theory and simulation that for enough diverse workload, heterogeneous chip multi-core processor(CMP) can deliver higher performance per watt over comparable homogeneous multicore processor. But, the prerequisite is that operating system can recognize this diversity and then take an effective and reasonable task scheduling. We implemented an asymmetric aware scheduler based on program behavior offline analysis, which makes up the shortcoming of online analysis and can achieve accurate thread-to-core initial assignment when a thread is created. Preliminary evaluation shows that our scheduler can gain performance improvement over default heterogeneous-agnostic scheduler and gain quality of service guaranteed.

articleTitle: A Service Encapsulation Architecture for Engineering Software Based on SOOA
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: SOOA (Service object-oriented architecture) is suitable to construct the service sharing environment for engineering software on the dynamic network. After analyzing the service encapsulation requirements of engineering software, an SOOA-based service encapsulation architecture for engineering software (SooSEA) is proposed. In the developed SooSEA-based system, engineering software tools can be encapsulated as services by product developers without the need of programming, and the encapsulated services can be accessed and utilized through a standard Web browser. The efficient sharing of engineering software resources can be achieved in the dynamic network environment.

articleTitle: Convergence Model Application on Regional Economy in Liaoning Province
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on the regional convergence model and using panel data of 14 cities for the period 1990-2008, this paper makes a test on whether there has regional economic convergence in Liaoning Province. The analysis results suggest that regional economic growth of Liaoning Province does have neither σ-convergence nor unconditional β-convergence during the whole period, which signifies that the regional economic disparities will not disappear spontaneously. To try to test for the conditional β-convergence we introduce more economic variables to convergence model. The results show there has conditional β-convergence. The urbanization level, fixed asset investment' foreign direct investment, employee number and the secondary industry level prove the major factors to influence regional economic growth.

articleTitle: Target Identification Based on Neural Network and D-S Evidence Theory
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a method of multisensor data fusion based on neuron network and reasoning (Dempster-Shafer evidence reasoning).The method can use deal with the inaccuracy and fuzzy information by D-S Evidence. And also it can give a full play to self-study of neural net, self-adapting and fault tolerant ability. In this way it has doughty robustness to uncertain information and improves the system identification rate. Then the D-S evidence is used to fuse the results derived from the neural network at different time. The result of computer simulation shows the method is effective and correct.

articleTitle: A Kind of Single-phase Active Power Filter Based on the Principle of Power Balance
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A method, which is used to control a kind of single-phase active power filter (APF) based on the principle of power balance, is introduced in this article. According to this method, the input active component required in the whole system can be obtained through the regulation of DC side voltage feedback, from the perspective of active energy balance. It does not need complex harmonic wave detection, just one current signal and one voltage signal, so that the entire control system can be simplified. In addition, the reactive component of system current can also be adjusted in similar methods, thus a kind of active power filter with Static Var Generator function is achieved. The simulation results show that the filter has good static and dynamic compensation performance, high practical value, and a certain role in promoting the development of smart grid.

articleTitle: Number List-based Interval Labeling Scheme for Structural Index Building of Encrypted XML Data
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: XML documents changing will lead to global index information updating in existing literatures for encrypted XML data querying schemes. There should have a scheme considering updating efficiency of index information for encrypted XML data. The paper presents the number list-based interval labeling scheme (NLBILS) for encrypted XML data. The basic idea is that if there have not enough space available for nodes inserting, the labeling process assigns a number for the sub-tree to be inserted, and then start with a new labeling process for each node in the sub-tree. The labeling result of each node will be consisting of a number list with its parent's nodes label. The proposed scheme makes index information maintenance more efficient, and it is easy to update XML data with decreasing the number of affected nodes to the lowest. The evaluation results show that the proposed scheme supports index information maintenance in an efficient way. The proposed scheme can be used to build structural index information for encrypted XML data query processing.

articleTitle: Distribution Network Design with Considering Externality
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The externality exists in distribution transportation widely with negative impacts on the whole society. However, these negative external costs have hardly been considered in total cost of enterprise operations, which results in that the best solutions of distribution network for enterprises are usually not the best one for the whole society. This article studies the distribution network design with considering externality of transportation, firstly setting up a concept model and secondly putting the experience data to get different networks with different externality rates. The article further analyzes the results of distribution networks with different rates and recognizes that the valuation of externality rate is the key for distribution network design and the external costs should be brought into the social total cost to get the optimal network design.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Small Target Tracking in Sports Video Based on IMM
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: For tracking and measuring maneuvering target in sports video frequency, Kalman Filter(KF) and Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) has been widely used, but the tracking effect is inaccuracy. A model combined with Interaction Multiple Model (IMM) algorithm and Debiased consistent Converted Measurements Kalman Filter (CMKF-D) algorithm is proposed for tracking and measuring the target in sports video frequency. It avoids the error caused by transferring non-linear model to linear model through EKF and KF. The football video frequency simulation shows this algorithm can promote the tracking performance of maneuvering target in sports video frequency.

articleTitle: A Low-power Oriented Dynamic Hybrid Cache Partitioning for Chip Multi-processor
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: As the number of cores on CMP increases, the size of an on-chip cache increases and it consumes more and more power of the whole system. So low-power oriented design has become an inevitable trend. However currently most of the partitioning strategies are aimed at throughput or fairness, ignore the power consumption. In order to reduce system power consumption, a new low-power-oriented hybrid partitioning (LPHP) strategy for shared cache is proposed in this paper. Due to the program locality principle, it uses both private and shared resource-allocation methods to implement the partitioning strategy by combining the two threads whose access appears large difference into one partitioning unit at run-time. Then when running the same application, some of the cache columns can be closed within the performance degradation threshold (PDT).

articleTitle: A New Evolving Data Streams System with Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Cluster analysis is an important data mining issue, where objects under investigation are grouped into subsets of the original set of objects. In recent several years, a few clustering algorithms have been developed for the data stream problem. However these algorithms lack of extensibility or efficiency. In this paper we propose a new evolving data streams system with data fusion. We discuss a fundamentally different philosophy for data stream clustering which is guided by application centered requirements. The system is highly suitable for real-time implementation and is demonstrated through a series of experiments. The experiments over a number of real and synthetic data sets illustrate the effectiveness and efficiency.

articleTitle: An Approach for XML Data Decomposition with Integrity Checking in XML Multisignature Scheme
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: XML multisignature schemes support more than one signer to sign different portions within an XML document. Therefore, how to decompose XML data is a big problem. Two issues should be considered in XML data decomposition. First, each subdocument divided is meaningful. Second, a integrity checking mechanism should be provided to ensure the integrity of each subdocument. The paper utilizes XPath expression to transform XML data, and generates an XML data integrity-checking pool to provide integrity-checking for decomposed XML data. Using XPath expression, it is easy to decompose an XML document while keeping the subdocument meaningful. With integrity-checking pool proposed, a signer can check integrity without cooperation from other signers. XML data does not need to be delegated entirely, and signers can complete integrity verification off-line.

articleTitle: Deep Packet Inspection Research Based on Hardware Acceleration
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This article studied on the line-speed Deep Packet Inspection, analyzing and studying the multi-pattern matching algorithm. Based on the reasonable grouping and storage for patterns, proposing a multi-pattern matching algorithm based on TCAM acceleration. Performance analyzing showed that, the algorithm had lower cost than the other algorithm based on hardware, and made the use of the advantages of TCAM. It could satisfy the line-speed demand in the real-time multi-pattern matching inspection.

articleTitle: Near Field High Resolution Numerical Simulation of Tohoku 2011 Tsunami on Multi-core System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: We use Finite Volume Method based on Shallow-water equation to simulate the Tohoku 2011 tsunami and parallelize the code using OpenMP. With the parallelization, we achieved over 80% of the potential speed-up on multi-core system. Using adaptive mesh refinement (AMR) to obtain high resolution result in important region, and the highest resolution near Sendai airport and Fukushima nuclear power plants is about 20 meters.

articleTitle: Integrating UML-RT and Function Block with Function Block Adapters
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The modeling of complex control system is usually based on the UML, thus the distributed control system is generally constructed by function block. This paper studies the modeling element: Function Block Adapter, which responsible for the connection of UML-RT capsule and IEC 61131 function block. By an application to a realistic manufacturing system, the author describes the concept, structure and interface of FBA. This paper also discusses a special FBA-language, which defines the operation of FBA.

articleTitle: Research on Frequency Modulation System for AC Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on the introduction of components and principle of frequency modulation system of constant frequency AC power supply, math model of frequency modulation system is established. The simulation with parameters changed under the state of middling rotate speed and middling load of the engine was discussed in details. The simulation results show that the change of system parameters would affect the dynamic and static characteristic of system.

articleTitle: The Design of a Practical Temperature Measurement Module Based on ARM
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Temperature is an important measurement parameter in industrial process control system. This paper introduces a temperature measurement system by using thermal resistor based on ARM. This module adds RC circuit to obtain the thermal resistor's resistance, and processes the data that is based on the sectional linear and designs low pass filter to improve precision. This circuit has good performance and accuracy by observing experiment data.

articleTitle: Improved Modulation Method for Optical Module Based on Compensation Technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In order to increase the performance of the optical module, an improved modulation method based on compensation technology is provided. Firstly, the development of the optical module is illustrated. Secondly, the combination and the main parameters of the optical module are listed. Thirdly, in according to the existing module package, the method based on compensation technology is elaborated. Finally, this method is used in one of internet device and the experimental results show that this method is able to ensure the superior performance of the module.

articleTitle: A Design of Platform System Supporting Dynamic Workflow Interoperation and Enterprise Application Integration
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a framework supporting dynamic interoperation between heterogeneous workflow systems and workflow-based dynamic Enterprise Application Integration (EAI). To this end, based on Sub-flow Task Model and Multi-Tiered Dynamic State Transition Model, three major components are defined: communicator, connectors, and automator. Communicator is the inter-system communication component of EAI Platform. Communicator handles communication within EAI Platform, and together with the Connector, lets customers, partners, enterprise systems, and EAI Platform's own internal components exchange messages and information using a common interface. Connectors are the system integration components of EAI Platform. Connectors move data between systems-whether these systems are internal to your business enterprise, or belong to a business-to-business partner. Automator supports the Unified Modeling Language (UML) standard for process modeling and the Workflow Management Coalition (WfMC) standard for process automation systems.

articleTitle: Coaxial Line Reflection Model for Dielectric Measurements of Oil Shale as Functions of Frequency
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The simulation model and equivalent circuit of coaxial line for dielectric measurements are described. The calculation of coaxial line reflection method, the expression of dielectric constant part and the imaginary part of the relative complex permittivity are solved. By using the program HFSS, we analyzed the reflection coefficient of sample and compared the simulation with the actual value of the complex permittivity, and also we analyzed the reflection coefficient of sample and given the differences between the model with adapter and the model without adapter. The effect of lumped capacitance on the resonance of coaxial cavity is further discussed. Finally, the resonance frequencies of different coaxial cavity model are given for chosen and compared.

articleTitle: A Parallel Algorithm of Frequent Itemsets Mining Based on Bit Matrix
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Mining frequent item sets is an important issue in association rules community. This paper proposes a parallel algorithm for mining frequent item sets based on bit matrix. The algorithm reduces the memory space and the I/O overhead, for it scans database only once and builds a compressed bit matrix. It combines both top-down approach and bottom-up approach to improve the efficiency of pruning, and uses dynamic scheduling parallel multi-threaded of OpenMP to mine frequent item sets. The experiments show that this algorithm has higher computing efficiency than Apriori algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the Key Technology of Simulation System Model Management
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Simulation system integration is a very huge and complex system project. Model management is a very important aspect to simulation system integration. In this paper, according to model representation is different, model portability is poor and model application modes are different, it is used that utilizing MNF to describe model standardized, and utilizing model library management system to manage model of storage, query and maintenance. In the last, it is provided that a strategy of model application.

articleTitle: Honeynet Systems Based on Genetic Algorithm Log Mining
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This article introduces the honeynet network structure and working mechanism from the perspective of network security technology, makes an in-depth analysis of honeynet technologies, and brings in suspicious behavior directed security strategies. It Introduces honeynet systems based on genetic algorithm log detection, and makes a rather further study of data mining using genetic algorithms.

articleTitle: High Performance Algorithm for Twiddle Factor of Variable-size FFT Processor and its Implementation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new storage and address accessing scheme of twiddle factors based on Multi-bank memory architecture. It makes the three twiddle factors needed by a mixed-radix 4/2 butterfly operation can be accessed simultaneously. It also makes it possible to design a variable-size FFT processor with only one three-bank twiddle factor lookup table which is advantageous over those other existing algorithms that need double of it. The algorithm proposed can be implemented with only one shift register and an accumulator. In addition, the access number of one of the three banks and its size are reduced by half. Therefore, its implementation is low complexity and area saving.

articleTitle: The Realization and Research of One Aviation Network Switch Simulation System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Aviation network switch is the key of Aviation network. The point of Aviation network research is ensuring the correctness of Aviation network switch design. The simulation system of Aviation network switch this paper realizes can simulate the real communication of Aviation network. It can find the design blemish of prototype system early and availably, which shorten development period greatly. Aiming at the characteristic of high real-time of Aviation network switch, this paper researches the setting of credit number of Aviation network switch. It provides reference data to balance the conflict of resource usage and throughput.

articleTitle: City Fire Risk Assessment Model Based on the Adaptive Genetic Algorithm and BP Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on the risk evaluation index system of city fire, a comprehensive evaluation model with the adaptive genetic algorithm and BP neural network (AGA-BP) is established in the article. In former process of the hybrid algorithm, the adaptive genetic algorithm is applied to adjust weights and thresholds of the three-layer BP neural network and train the BP neural network for locating the global optimum, and the error back propagation algorithm is used to search in neighborhoods of the approximate optimal solution in the later process. The program written in VB6.0 is used to learn some samples of city fire risk according to the AGA-BP algorithm and the general BP algorithm. The results show that the learning precision of AGA-BP algorithm is more correctly than that of the general BP algorithm. The training speed and convergence rate of the former is significantly improved because of the combination of AGA and BP algorithm. It is helpful to realize automated evaluation for city fire risk.

articleTitle: Relational Perspectives on Covering Based Rough Approximation Operators
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Generalized rough set models based on arbitrary binary relation and covering are two meaningful extensions of Pawlak's rough set, and their relationship is an important and interesting issue. Any covering can induce two binary relations, one being a tolerance and the other being the specialization preorder. In this paper, four pairs of covering based rough upper and lower approximation operators are proved to be precisely Cech quasi-discrete closure and interior operators corresponding to the induced tolerance and specialization preordering, respectively. Axiomatic characterizations of these four types of covering rough upper (dually, lower) approximation operators are also discussed.

articleTitle: Splitting Strategy for Wireless Sensor Network Based on Cluster Coverage
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: We propose a splitting strategy for wireless sensor network based on cluster coverage. We cluster the network and divide nodes into different partitions based on the information of cluster nodes and classification of energy value. In each round only one partition used for monitoring in a cluster and other partitions can sleep. When the energy of partition is exhausted, another partition will be wakeup to monitoring. Thus energy can be saved as much as possible. The experiment verifies the effectiveness of this approach.

articleTitle: Functional Verification Flow for an Embedded Microprocessor
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Design verification is the process of determining that a design accurately represents the developer's conceptual description and specifications. These days, design verification represents bring about 60% of total cost of the development of microprocessors or microprocessor cores. A huge number of different activities performed in different stages of the design flow and at different levels of abstraction. Based on the analysis of the structure of an embedded microprocessor, this paper shows the hierarchical verification flow for the microprocessor. The verification flow integrates several verification methods such as coding style checking, register transfer level simulation based on module, system level simulation, virtual machine based verification, timing verification and FPGA based verification. The embedded microprocessor has been successfully fabricated on the SIMC 0.18 μm COMS technology.

articleTitle: Asymptotic Analytical Solutions of a Two Coupled Duffing-Van Der Pol Oscillators Using the Extended Homotopy Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: We consider a two coupled Duffing-van der Pol oscillators with a nonlinear coupling in this paper. The extended homotopy analysis method (EHAM) is used to obtain the asymptotic analytical series solutions of the system. Meanwhile, we establish the comparisons between the results of the EHAM and standard Runge-Kutta numerical method and good agreement is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on Key Problems of A-Interface over IP
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the current trend of all IP based mobile network, transformation of traditional TDM-based 2G BSS is the last problem to be solved.. International standards have just completed the definition of A-interface over IP, and Industry achievement has not been totally completed. In this paper, the key problems and the industrial progress of A-interface over IP deployment are introduced, and the recommended solutions about deployment strategy A-interface over IP are proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Equipment Maintenance Support Resources Dispatch Model in Wartime
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Through researching on the reasons causing the resources conflict in wartime, the resources optimization dispatching model of multi-spot of maintenance of the equipment maintenance support system was founded, and an optimization dispatching arithmetic of multi-spot of maintenance based on precedence was proposed, then this paper expound the steps of the arithmetic, at last educe conclusion.

articleTitle: The Numerical Simulation for Compaction of Loose Defects of Large Forgings with DEFORM
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: For the solution of the problem that compaction of loose defects inside ingot is more difficult than forging cavitary defects together, in this paper, numerical simulation with DEFORM software is performed for the compaction process of loose defects inside forging of low-pressure rotor of 600MW steam turbine, the Simulation results are basically consistent with experimental results, it shows that the simulation for loose defects with properties of porous materials from DEFORM is possible, it is referenceable for the study on variation of loose density in forging process of rotor.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Mobile Payment Security Middleware
