publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Aiming at solving the security problem in mobile payment, a kind of mobile payment security middleware is proposed. The middleware inherits the thought of the basic level of traditional security but abandons its complexity, and uses open standards and mature source platform, so it has good interoperability and higher flexibility.

articleTitle: Coherent Control of Terahertz Pulses Polarization in ZnTe Crystal
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a theoretical analysis of the coherent control of terahertz pulses polarization with a pair of temporally separated and orthogonally polarized laser pump pulses with the same central frequency. It is found that for a (110)-oriented ZnTe crystal, the single-cycle terahertz pulse can be controlled from linear polarization to elliptical polarization with different trajectories by varying the relative time delay between the incident pump pulses. Moreover, the reasons of the discrepancy between the theoretical description and the former experimental results are discussed also.

articleTitle: Studies on the Evolutionary Characteristics of Reply Networks on BBS
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on the complex network theories, we studied the evolution of reply networks on BBS in this paper. At first, we built directed reply networks using data information downloaded from BBS plates. Then we studied the evolutionary characteristics of network topology with time, including the number of additional nodes and links, clustering coefficient, characteristic path length, and degree distribution. With these statistical data, the regular patterns of evolutionary process of reply networks are discovered which helps to get potential information on BBS and to construct evolutionary model of reply networks on BBS.

articleTitle: K Granularity and Generalizd K Granularity Rough Set Model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The generalization of rough set is an important issue in rough set theory. In this paper, firstly, the concept of K-granularity rough relation is introduced, new models of K-granularity and generalized K-Granularity fuzzy rough sets are proposed based on the Dubois model, and then theirs structure are defined and properties proved. Secondly, some regularities of the changing of this model with the different granularity are discussed based on the attributes, and a method for measuring the uncertainty of the model is that monotonously increasing with the subdivision of granularity is proposed based on different granularity in this K-granularity fuzzy rough set. It can provide a theoretical basis for application of rough set in reality. Finally, an example is given to show the validity and effectiveness of K-granularity fuzzy rough set.

articleTitle: SVM-based Hypertext Information Categorization
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: An algorithm of hypertext information categorization based on SVM was introduced. The algorithm divided a large data-set into many non-intersecting subsets during training period, in which the samples are trained according to the batch and then many classifications are constructed. The classifications are optimized by error correcting output codes (ECOC), which reduces the amount of documents to be studied in the deep level training phase. The application of this algorithm to hypertext information categorization underlines the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-echelon Inventory Model of Repairable Spare Parts with Lateral Transshipments
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Lateral transshipments policy of repairable spare parts among the same echelon departments has an important function to improve the availability of the weapon equipment in the multi-echelon support system. The multi-echelon inventory model with lateral transshipments was researched in this paper. In the mathematical model, the minimum value of expected backorders under the constraint of support budget was used as optimizing objective, and the model was analyzed through the simulation of a practical instance.

articleTitle: Communities of Autonomous Units for Heterogeneous Applications Monitoring Systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the scale of computer business systems inflate unceasingly recently, heterogeneous applications increase dramatically. In the operation and maintenance of computer application business systems, heterogeneous applications monitoring systems are becoming indispensable tools to make systems available continuously. In order to reflect the situation of monitoring objects instantly, we proposed and investigated a framework based on communities of autonomous units.

articleTitle: Oscillation Theorem of Second-Order Half-Linear Dynamic Equations with Damping on Time Scales
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we consider second-order half-linear dynamic equation with damping. By employing the Riccati technique we will establish some new sufficient conditions which ensure that every solution oscillates or converges to zero.

articleTitle: Improving Secure Server Performance by EAMRSA SSL Handshakes
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: SSL is a cryptographic protocol that is widely used in secure applications based on web browser. SSL servers are often overloaded with many simultaneous requests. So it is important to look for faster algorithms in order to speed up decryption stages for improve SSL performance. In the paper, we investigate the performance of EAMRSA algorithm which improves the performance by load transferring technique in SSL/TLS handshake protocol. This technique facilitates more favorable load distribution by requiring clients to perform more work (as part of encryption) and servers to perform commensurately less work, thus resulting in better SSL throughput. The solution improves the performance of the SSL system. Theoretical results demonstrate that the method can speed up processing of RSA private key operations by a factor of between 4.5 to 18, depending on the RSA key size.

articleTitle: Agreement of General Sampled-data Multi-agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper focuses on looking for the maximum allowable sampling period for multi-agent systems with general linear dynamical agents. As long as the sampling period is less than the bound, there exists a linear agreement protocol solving the agreement problem of the sampled-data multi-agent systems. Firstly, the agreement problem is converted to the simultaneously stabilizing problem of some specific systems. Secondly, the maximum allowable sampling period for SISO sampled-data multi-agent systems is provided based on the instable eigenvalues of continuous-time system matrix. Then by solving the H∞ optimal control problem of certain system with uncertainty, an allowable bound of sampling period is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on the Multiple Incentive Model of Mobilization Center
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: National economy mobilization centre is a micro mechanism with economic and social benefits established to solve the supply and demand of weapons and equipment, technology, materials and labor resources when faced with war or emergencies. The establishment of an effective incentive and restraint mechanisms for the mobilization centre is of vital importance to maintain the mobilizing ability of the mobilization centre. After analysing the Principal-Agent relationship between the mobilization organization and the mobilization center in the mobilization activity, a multi-stimulating model for the mobilization center is constructed based on the agent-principal theory. In the normal Principal-Agent model, the output is taken as the stimulating variable. However, the degree of hard working for the mobilization center in the peacetime is added into our model as the inspecting variable in order to realize the multi-stimulating. The results show that the monitoring signal improves the stimulating effect of the mobilization center, hence, offers the theory base for the management of the mobilization center.

articleTitle: Study on Layout Strategy of Transit Hub Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Transit hubs are the fundamental facilities to anchor the urban transit network system and to connect various passenger transport modes. This paper makes a definition of transit hub's connotation at first, analyzes the functions and characteristics of transit hub, and then represents the evolution of transit hub's spatial structure. Optimal transit hub locating strategies are designed under two basic scenarios: pre-determined transit network and unknown transit network. Under the pre-determined transit network case, the optimal strategy can be described as "service zoning and route classifying", while under the unknown transit network case, the optimal strategy can be summarized as "hub hierarchy, service zoning and route classifying".

articleTitle: A Survey of Adaptive Disparity Estimation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Intermediate View Synthesis (IVS) is a key technology in multi-view display, and it is widely used in many fields, such as three dimensional (3D) television, 3D tele-videoconference, 3D video application, robot vision, virtual machine, medical surgery and so on. Disparity estimation is one of main methods of IVS. Some new intermediate view reconstruction techniques based on the adaptive disparity estimation algorithms are proposed. The development and current status of adaptive estimation are analyzed. The problems with IVS based on adaptive window matching are discussed.

articleTitle: The Implementation of Layered Sensor Network Based on Semantic Technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In the recent years, sensor network becomes more and more common. It has wide-range commercial and daily applications from surveillance to smart home, from raw data collection to context awareness. With the development of the semantic technology, the sensor network has changed significantly. In this paper we propose an architecture of four-layered sensor network: the hardware platform layer consists of various sensors which provide raw data; the network layer organizes the network based on ZigBee; and the semantic processing layer uses OWL to built ontology for data understanding, and the application layer provide a platform for users to design and build the semantic service. It adds the flexibility and interoperability effectively. Finally, we design an experimental platform to test and verify the feasibility of the proposed layered architecture and the application of the semantic technology for data processing in the sensor network. The experimental results show that the sensor network based on layered architecture operates stably and the semantic improves the efficiency of data processing.

articleTitle: Reconstruction Based on the Robot VISION Exploration and Methods of Hierarchical Analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: To some extent, the paper analyzes the principle of hierarchical reconstruction of the impact of the robot. Image recognition is given to the affine point from the image reconstruction of the corresponding instance of calculated measures, which is a measure of the corresponding affine point reconstruction needs of the most basic structural information, such as metric reconstruction of seculars reflection based on reconstruction, the measure of similar objects based on reconstruction, reconstruction based on the measurement of moving objects, and based on hidden consumption point of the metric reconstruction to improve image clarity.

articleTitle: Different Shape Object Layout Problem Solving Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Through analyzing the characteristics of the layout of different shape objects, according to the basic idea of genetic algorithm, which is proposed based on the layout algorithm for different objects. The algorithm to select the appropriate encoding method, genetic operators and the appropriate adaptive function, The experimental results show that the algorithm converges fast to solve premature, and that in a short time to get a better layout program.

articleTitle: A Cloud Platform for the Campus Mobile Community
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: For the past decades, people, especially students, became accustomed to handle everything online as much as possible. While the development of cloud, they are also encouraged to use the computing resources and the large-scale data of clouds just on "thin" devices, such as on iPads and cell phones. This paper presents a cloud computing platform architecture for campus mobile community. We implement a prototype system and evaluate it. It provides a design pattern for the campuses to build their cloud and mobile communication platform.

articleTitle: Research of Cross-Layer and Multi-Hops Algorithm Based on Energy and Location
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Network topology control mechanism is one of the key technologies of wireless sensor networks, a good topology can improve the efficiency of routing protocols, and routing algorithm is the key to routing protocols. Mainly based on the layer routing LEACH algorithm of the wireless sensor network, the article raises an improved algorithm, which optimizes selection by clustering head after improved and considering the residual energy and location of nodes and number of neighbor nodes. Communication between clusters is optimized by using cross-layer and multi-hops algorithm.

articleTitle: An Iterative Eigenvector Estimation Algorithm and its Application in Spectral Estimation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Through improvement of subspace iteration method and utilization of deflation technique, a new iterative algorithm for eigenvector estimation is presented. Compared to current eigenvector calculation methods such as SVD, the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce calculation burden and complexity with high estimation accuracy, and it is easily implemented on time. Using this algorithm in spectrum estimation, it is known by computer simulation that the proposed algorithm attains higher spectrum estimation solution than that of standard MUSIC spectrum estimation method and needs less calculation, which proves the effectiveness and advantage of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Simulation Implementation of MCU Based on Multisim10 and C Language
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the development of embedded systems and system on chip, C51 series of single-chip has entered a new stage. The MCU Module has been added to the latest version of Multisim10, so it can be simulated and analyzed. A practical example is used to illustrate the basic operation process of Multisim10 MCU simulation module using C language by the flowing water light experimental studies in which 8051 single chip was taken as the control core. At the same time, the MCU system design can be proved feasibly. It will be of guidance significance for the development and application of embedded system.

articleTitle: Application of Multiscale Algorithm to Material Efficiency for Rhombus Periodic Structure
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper we discuss the multiscale asymptotic expansion for a kind of general second order elliptic problem with rapidly oscillating coefficients in parallel tope periodic structure. Based on the theoretical result, i.e. the property of effective coefficient when applying isotropic scaling, we investigate exhaustively the effect of structure parameters on the effective material coefficient by numerical simulations.

articleTitle: Deep Soft Rock Tunnel Support Technology and Simulation in Fanshan Phosphate Mine
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The depth of the horizontal tunnel in Fanshan Phosphate Mine is over 350m, and the tunnel is disturbed by the stoping of working face, so it is difficult to support. Based on engineering geological survey and analysis we find the damage reason of tunnel, research the deformation mechanism and damage of deep tunnel with soft rock and confirm the compound deformation mechanism, in addition, combining the simulation results we put forward the anchor-mesh-cable support programs. The results show that the program can give full play to the coupling supporting of anchor-mesh-cable and control the deformation of tunnel effectively, therefore it creates a safe conditions for production.

articleTitle: The Malfunction Analysis and Examination of a Communicate Difference Electric Motor
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The article detailed introduces familiar breakdowns and the early sign of the breakdown appearance of the exchange difference electric motor, examine from the signal, the signal processing, the breakdown examine that three levels analyze and ratio currently the most basic breakdown of the diagnosis method and principle to the exchange difference electric motor. All methods and theorieseses have beneficial and fraud, should various methods blend, take to grow to repair mutually short, then can be better to carry on the diagnosis of the breakdown of the exchange difference electric motor.

articleTitle: The Nuclear Clustering Algorithm of a Class of Metric Space
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Through a number of lemma and theorems, nuclear clustering method proposed in this paper solves a class of space-metric nuclear clustering, which uses matrix elementary transformations and adopts a nonlinear mapping to extract differentiate and amplify characteristics of useful information. This method strives to avoid clustering that uses the characteristics of the sample directly. Even though the spread of the sample is uneven or the sample distribution is chaos, nuclear clustering method can achieve accurate clustering. This paper also gives the algorithm of nuclear clustering.

articleTitle: The Interpretation and Building of VLC
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Virtual Learning Community, as a kind of Virtual Community, has become a hot research in recent years. This article introduces the Virtual Community first of all, and then focuses on the definition and essential characteristics of VLC. Finally, discusses building a VLC by using P2P technologies to achieve self-study and research-study of constructivism education.

articleTitle: The Design and Realization of the Angular Acceleration Detecting Channel for Auto-transmission Based on the Labview and Newton Interpolation Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the design of angular acceleration detecting channel for the outputting shaft of auto-transmission. The article introduces the principle of speed detection and designs corresponding signal processing circuit. It also introduces the Newton interpolation method and basing on the method, derives the expression of angle acceleration. This paper explains how to design labview programme to calculate angle acceleration by the Newton interpolation method. also, it collects experimental data to analyze the algorithm compared with the calculated results of matlab, then validate the correctness of the algorithm.

Author Keywords: Bench of synthesis performance for vehicle automatic transmission

articleTitle: Semi-supervised Local Linear Embed Algorithm Based on Side-information
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The local linear embedded algorithm (LLE) is a typical no-supervised learning method. Due to that LLE cannot utilize the known information, it cannot achieve a perfect learning result. Side-information is also a kind of label information, which is relatively easier to get. Based on it, a new algorithm, semi-supervised local linear embedded (SFLLE), has been developed. This new method utilize the both the positive and negative constrain to overcome the shortcoming of the previous LLE method. The experiment result demonstrated the validation of this method.

articleTitle: Acoustic Source Localization Technology Research in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Localization technology is a hot research point in the sensor network area. For low power consumption and long life characteristics of sensor nodes, sound location technology has its specificities using in wireless sensor network. In this paper we proposed a sensor network with sound position function, in which three sensor nodes with acoustic sensor have been used to detect trajectory of a small car. This paper selects digital signal processors as controllers and processors for wireless sensor networks nodes. The experimental results show that this approach can achieve a good positioning of moving targets.

articleTitle: Research on Building of Enterprise Integrated Informatization Platform Based on Coordinated Management
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Facing the competition situation getting severe day by day, to enhance the inter-enterprise information interaction and service coordinated capability with the aid of informatization means becomes an important development trend for a great number of group enterprises. This article builds a enterprise integrated informatization platform for a geological and mineral resource prospecting group of Xinjiang combining the new concept of coordinated management, researches the system architecture, functional structure and implementation mode of the platform, and through analyzing the three-tier architecture of the system application platform, it eventually puts forward the concept design of the enterprise integrated informatization platform for the group.

articleTitle: An Improved TCP for Transaction Communication on Structured Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With Internet developing, not only the network infrastructure is evolving, but also the attached terminals and the applications based on it are diversifying. TCP is inefficient and even cannot meet the application requirements in some resource-limited environment, especially for particular application scenarios on Internet of Things or wireless sensor networks. In this paper, an improved TCP is proposed which optimizes connection setup and tear-down processes. It can not only guarantee connection security and data transfer reliability, but also enhance real-time performance, reduce communication overhead, and save power for communicating end nodes. This improved TCP has been simulated and executed on a production network, the final result shows that it is reliable and has a dramatic performance improvement over the traditional TCP.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Graph Software Watermarking Algorithm Based on Chaotic Theory
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this study we proposed a robust watermarking algorithm to improve the watermark hidden. The watermark information is separated with the Chinese Remainder Theorem at first and then use Planted Plane Cubic Tree enumeration encoding topology structure. At last the sub-watermarking is hashed to the entire program code by chaotic system to protect the entire program code. In the extracting procedure the user inputs secret key to restore the graph structure into a watermark information to prove his copyright. The experiments indicate its robustness and stealthiness is stronger and more practicable.

articleTitle: The Application Research of Cloud Computing in Military Intelligence Fusion
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The advantage of Cloud Computing supplies an important way for solving Military Intelligence Fusion (MIF). By analyzing the demand of MIF and combining the character of Cloud Computing, this paper takes out the sense of the application of Cloud Computing in MIF, brings forward the construction assumption of MIF system based on Cloud Computing, and also supplies reference to the application of Cloud Computing in data fusion.

articleTitle: Target Threat Assessment Based on Genetic Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Threat assessment is one of the most important problems in military applications and is the foundation of commanders to make decisions for their actions. In this paper, we concentrate on threat assessment based on the factors of space situation and air combat capacity of targets, such as altitude, distance and speed. After analyzing the threat assessment model of targets, a target threat level assessment method based on genetic neural network is proposed to estimate the threat level of aerial targets. Experiment shows that genetic neural network can solve the problem of target threat level assessment and using genetic neural network to predict target threat level is an effective method.

articleTitle: Research on Spatial Object-oriented Management Information System for Hydropower Station Project
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In order to intuitive and meticulous manage the hydropower station project construction, in view of the current commonly-used project management systems of the contract-oriented system and the schedule-oriented system, a spatial object-oriented project construction management concept is proposed. The definition of project construction spatial cellular management is given at first. Based on the definition, combined with the characteristics of hydropower station project management, in the construction measure control network of hydropower project, according to the contract of the project scope, a 3D object model is built with the measured data in construction process. Then the object was dispersed based on the quality check elements. Relationship can be built between the management attributes and the elements, which will facilitate the project management. At last, it is introduced that the spatial elements of the object-oriented hydropower station project construction management system from build engineering object, engineering object segmentation and object attributes management application step.

articleTitle: An Aspect-based Model for Non-Invasive Fault Tolerant Software
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Traditional development of fault-tolerant software involves fault tolerance logic in business logic. It imposes developers concern about non-functional logic more, and reduces the maintainability of the system. This paper proposed a non-invasive fault-tolerant model to support dynamically weave fault-tolerant logic into exist system based on AOP and replicates technology; analyzed the methods to modeling aspects and dynamic weaving mechanism; defined a set of indicators to evaluate the invasion level quantitatively; finally, implemented and tested a JavaEE system to validate this model. Experimental results show that the model can effectively promote development productivity and maintainability of fault tolerance software.

articleTitle: Design of BMD Measurement System Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In order to diagnose Osteoporosis (OP), it is important to get the information of the bone mineral density (BMD). The Quantitative Ultrasound (QUS) measurement is proved to be a reliable method for detecting the BMD. Broadband Ultrasonic Attenuation (BUA) and Speed of Sound (SOS) are two important parameters of the QUS. Based on the QUS theory and the technology of FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array), we introduce the BMD measurement system to measure the values of BUA and SOS. This system includes the ultrasonic bone density instrument and software process method. The weak signal of measurement is amplified, filtered, detected, received and processed in this system. Through a mass of experiments on people in different age groups, it indicates that this system is effective in detecting quantitative ultrasound parameters and is able to meet the need of Osteoporosis diagnosis.

articleTitle: The Measurable Fuzzy Sets
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The objective of this paper is to propose a measure and a metric of measurable fuzzy sets, which are defined in this paper. With such a measure and a metric ambiguity and fuzziness of measurable fuzzy sets are introduced and discussed through examples from reality.

articleTitle: SATD Cost Research on Intra Mode Predictions for H.264/AVC
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: H.264/AVC is one of the most efficient international video coding standards. In this standard, intra-prediction with SATD (sum absolute transform distortion) cost calculation is applied. In this paper, the distributions of the intra-prediction modes' cost are studied and compiled by statistics method in both 16×16 and 4×4 blocks in I-frame. The simulation result shows that the distributions of the cost can be modeled as F distribution.

articleTitle: A Method for Fault Diagnosis in Missile Based on Fuzzy Petri Net
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the complexity of missile equipment, Fuzzy Petri Net is applied to the method of modeling fault transmission. Fuzzy production rules are introduced into knowledge representation and the fault diagnosis method using fuzzy Petri Net. The result demonstrates that Fuzzy Petri Net has an easy structure, a good expression of faults and effective capability of fuzzy reasoning.

articleTitle: Application of Four Thresholds Edge Detection Algorithm for the Image Processing System of CNC Engraving Machine
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the development of engraving technology, engraving systems based on digital image processing technique has been accepted by the market with fast molding and low cost, and will be widely used in advertising, mould etc. In this study, the advantage of four thresholds algorithm is given by analyzing the problems of the traditional Canny edge detection algorithm. Then four thresholds algorithm is applied to the image processing system of CNC engraving machine. Experimental results show that the algorithm can efficiently and accurately detect the contour to engrave image.

articleTitle: A Model Based on Multiagent for Collaborative Design
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: According to the characteristics of dynamic environment in manufacturing, This paper proposes a model of collaborative multi-Agent based on intention tracing in this model, the Agent chooses cooperative objects to form a team by tracing the acquaintances' intention. The model divides the whole coordination into parts operated by different departments, effectively reducing the expanses of system resources.

articleTitle: An Energy-efficient Routing Algorithm for Data Gathering in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Clustering routing algorithm is widely used in data gathering to reduce data latency, enhance network scalability, and prolong the network lifetime. When sensor nodes transmit their data to the sink via multi-hop communication, the sensor nodes closer to the sink are burdened with more relay traffic and die early, which will cause network partitions. This paper presents a based uneven clustering algorithm to solve the problem of energy consumption that is not balanced. Simulation results show that the routing algorithm is well balanced the energy consumption of the network, and prolongs the network lifetime.

articleTitle: Optimal Network Hardening Model Based on Parallel Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Because the existed approaches to harden networks have an unavoidable exponential worse-case complexity, and are not scalable to large networks, this paper proposes an optimal network hardening model (ONHM) based on parallel genetic algorithm by combining attack graphs and parallel genetic algorithm. Firstly, we describe the optimal network hardening problem; secondly, we establish a corresponding mathematical model, which converts the optimal network hardening problem to a non-restraint optimization problem with penalty. Through a large number of repeated laboratory tests, the experimental results show ONHM can find the optimal network hardening, and can be applied to large-scale networks.

articleTitle: Research of Occupation Match Evaluation Based on Multi-objective Optimization
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the scores of Holland and vocational aptitude assessment test and some other information are used on the models of seeker-to-job satisfaction and job-to-seeker satisfaction to calculate the specific satisfaction scores. Satisfaction models use structural equation model (SEM) to get the importance of each factor weight distribution, and to calculate the satisfaction scores on the basis of the weights. Based on the two models of satisfaction, the system uses multi-objective optimization model to get the best match of job seekers and posts. The related system uses B/S structure, and is based on SQL Server2005, using ASP.net technology to support business users match the n job seekers and m jobs and obtain the optimal solution.

articleTitle: The Global Rank Axioms for Poset Antimatroids
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The concept of rank function of the poset antimatroid is introduced, and the rank axioms for poset antimatroids are investigated. A "pseudo-global" rank axioms are presented for poset antimatroids. Some properties of poset antimatroid are obtained.

articleTitle: Estimation of Eigenvalues for a Sort of Matrixes
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In order to estimate eigenvalues of matrix, an improvement on Ky Fan's theorem of matrix eigenvalues will be given in the article in terms of Perron roots and Perron vectors of positive (or irreducible nonnegative) matrices. At the same time, some examples are shown to test the results.

articleTitle: Research on Information Security Risk Control and Legal Regulation of Typical Cloud Computing Services
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Current cloud computing services lack comprehensive management and legal constraints, which lead cause a series of development issues including information security. This paper analyzes eight (potential/possible) security risks of typical cloud computing services, proposing risk control strategies and legal regulation proposals for safety supervision.

articleTitle: The Design of Differentially Expressed Gene Recognition Software Based on Meta-analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: As the traditional analysis of differentially expressed genes can only handle a single data sets, we designed and developed the differentially expressed genes recognition software based on meta-analysis to analyze differentially expressed gene. The Software integrated Rank Product meta-analysis algorithm and improvement RSDM algorithm with filtering techniques based on standard deviation. The software has realized the data import and the analysis of differentially expressed gene. Experimental results show that: the software can effectively analyze heterogeneous data sets, find differentially expressed genes, and thus verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Design of Simulation Platform for IEEE 802.16 MAC Protocol
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Targeting at providing wireless broadband access in metropolitan area networks, the IEEE 802.16 standard group has established a sub-group to study new protocol. Wireless mesh network (WMN) becomes the research hotspot in communication areas as it can be used to solve "the last mile" problem. To test the performance of IEEE 802.16 MAC protocol, the self-design simulation platform is proposed. In the article, backbone for simulation platform is designed in detail. The simulation platform supports operation and systematic simulation of MAC protocol that developed in actual project. Through combining theoretical study with practical development, the simulation platform can reduce workload from theoretical study to final realization. Using the simulation platform, the MAC layer program can be debugged, comprehensive performance can be evaluated. The study method of designing simulation platform can provide new ideas for protocol study.

articleTitle: Data Abstraction and Digital Simulation in Chinese Medicine Production Training
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Working position drive is one of the most important links among the nodes of modern manufacturing. Chinese medicine pharmaceutical manufacturing is a typical case of working position drive; working nodes and operation actions can be described into data structures by abstracting working position data effectively; the entire workflow can be formed with various working nodes structured in series by workflow control technologies. By applying the principle of working position drive and workflow control, the development of Chinese medicine pharmaceutical manufacturing simulation system become simpler and clearer, and it is more practical.

articleTitle: A Novel Single Observer Passive Localization Method Based on MOEA
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A novel single observer passive localization method using DOA and TDOA based on Multi-objective Evolutionary Algorithm (MOEA) is presented, which avoids the drawback of traditional methods. Moreover, a simple and effective decision-making strategy for MOEA is designed. Experiments validate that without initialized estimate and linearization processing, the proposed method is steadily able to achieve a localization accuracy with small difference from Cramer-Rao Lower Bound (CRLB) under the condition of single observation. Finally, a conclusion can be drawn that solving passive localization problem from the perspective of multi-objective optimization is practicable.

articleTitle: Personalized Multimedia-Information Retrieval Model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With the public's enthusiasm for multimedia creation continues to increase, an easy retrieval technology and lots of multimedia materials are been needed. This paper proposed a Personalized Multimedia Service Model (PMSM)-The model that use a standard to identify kinds of multimedia materials as the same structure in order to gain the excellent efficiency. PMSM abandon traditional retrieval technology and achieve personalized service by using interest model. PMSM actively push the information to user, what user may be interested. Finally, an experiment is carried out to show that out approach is feasible.

articleTitle: A New Constant Square and One Norm Algorithm for Blind Equalization
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The Constant Modulus Algorithm is a mature algorithm for a long time. The researcher is fond of its solidity. The Constant Norm Algorithms are a family of algorithms. A new Constant Square and One Norm Algorithm is a joint algorithm for blind equalization. The computer simulation results demonstrate fast convergence.

articleTitle: ANN-Based Remote Sensing Estimation of Ecosystem Service Values in Meizhou Proper, China
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on land use/cover extracting from artificial neural network (ANN) classification of Landsat TM/ETM+ data, the ecosystem service values (ESVs) of Meizhou proper in 2001 and 2007 were studied by using remote sensing and Xie et al.'s method of ESV calculation. The annual total ESV in Meizhou proper was 582.3 million Yuan in 2001 and 581.1 million Yuan in 2007, with a slight decline of 1.2 million Yuan from 2001 to 2007 due to the reducing areas of garden plot, farmland and water body. The ESVs of soil formation & conservation and water conservation got the top two highest, and the ESV of food production the lowest one of all nine ecosystem functions. Land use/cover (LUC) changes were mainly responsible for the ESV variations in Meizhou proper. It is suggested that some measures such as a reasonable land use plan should be made to preserve the ecosystem services and promote "Green Rising" of Meizhou for sustainable development.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Gene Analytical Instrument Based on PMT
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A gene analysis system using photo multiplier tubes as the optical sensor is introduced in this article. This system consists of msp430f149 processor, optical system, location control system, signal acquisition and processing unit. The system can analyze the reagent's gene through detecting the fluorescence emitted from reagent. It has merits of high speed and high precision compared with real-time detection.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Adaptive Direct Generalized Predictive Control Based on LS-SVR Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Learning the multi-step forecast optimization strategy from Dynamic Matrix Control (DMC) and Model Algorithmic Control (MAC), Generalized Predictive Control (GPC) has a strong ability to overcome load disturbance, random noise and delay change, and the selected model has less parameter, so it is easy to control. But it also has some problems such as big amount of calculation and no consideration to both rapidity and over modulation. So an adaptive direct GPC method is proposed based on LS-SVR and tracking error. This method uses LS-SVR method to design predictive controller, and uses a modified projection algorithm, based on tracking error, to adjust the weight of LS-SVR adaptively, in order to avoid calculating the inverse matrix. The result indicates that the method not only is very effective but also reduces the calculation amount.

articleTitle: Design of Intrusion Detection Model Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper focuses on an improved FP-Growth algorithm. Preprocessing of data mining can increase efficiency on searching the common prefix of node and reduce the time complexity of building FP-tree. Based on the improved FP-Growth algorithm and other data mining techniques, an intrusion detection model is carried out. The experimental results demonstrate effectiveness of the improved algorithm and feasibility of intrusion detection model.

articleTitle: A Novel Algorithm of Image Splicing Detection
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Recent advances in computer technology have made digital image tampering more and more common. In this paper we present an approach to passive detection of image splicing. The image splicing detection problem can be regarded as a two-class classification problem under the pattern recognition framework. The features are extracted by image quality metrics (IQMs) and moments of characteristic functions of wavelet subbands. To evaluate the performance of our proposed model, we further present a concrete implementation of this model. Our experimental works have demonstrated that this splicing detection scheme performs effectively and have indicated that the proposed approach possesses promising capability in splicing detection.

articleTitle: An Agent-based Component for Web Geographic Information Systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: GIS is wildly used in archaeology, geography, cartography, remote sensing, land surveying, public utility management, natural resource management, precision agriculture, photogrammetry, urban planning, emergency management, landscape architecture, navigation, aerial video and localized search engines. We propose an intelligent agent-based component for Web GIS. The component comprises serveral coordinated agents for users to retrieve geographic information. Function logic of server part, processing logic of client part and underlying operation of system, including interaction with operating system, network, and database, are separately designed so as achieve maximal stability. Independence between modules ensures extensibility. Advanced functions such as map management, user management and data management are also integrated. By the Web GIS component, users can conduct roaming and zooming in several map layers, spatial information analysis and retrieval. The component provides API for application developers, data distributors and spatial database engine vendors so that they can add dynamic, data-driven map to applications. The component can be integrated into development environment easily, reducing application system complexity, easing development progress, sparing as much cost as possible and promoting maintainability as well.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Allocation for Information Resource Based on Carbon Management Certification
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Based on the project of Low Carbon City in China, which is sponsored by World Wildlife Fund (WWF), it is imperative to find a low carbon development approach in China. To achieve the low carbon goal, it is important to measure and control carbon emission. In this paper, the content of carbon resource footprint and carbon management capability are described. A carbon coordinate system, including share, replacement, recovery and recycle, is established. Research on quality engineering for carbon footprint is discussed. In this way, a strong technical support to systematically study the approach for low carbon resource is provided.

articleTitle: Research on Ultra Wide-Band Indoor Location System
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The structure of the Ultra Wide-Band (UWB) indoor location system is introduced firstly in the paper. Secondly the test environment is described in detail. Finally, the test results of the system are given out. It proposes reference value for researchers who are interested in UWB indoor location technology.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of Universal On-board Train Interface Unit
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Train Interface Unit (TIU) is the key execution unit of on board Automatic Train Protection (ATP) system. ATP system achieves the control of the train and information exchange with the train via TIU. Developing a TIU which fits for different train platform and is in compliance with the safety integrity level (SIL) 4 can greatly facilitate the system installation and lower operation and maintenance cost. This thesis has designed a TIU for a series of standard train platform. Based on the system design, four key technologies of TIU, include relay and Multifunction Vehicle Bus (MVB) interface, safety communication, emergency brake (EB) interface and service brake (SB) interface, are in-depth in anatomist. Through the thorough analysis and evaluation of the safety and real-time performance, we can get the conclusion that the TIU sub-system meets the requirements of the practical use.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Programming Model Based on Service-component
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: How to wrap the conventional distributed software component by the use of Web Service, wrap the service provided by isomerous component as automatically as possible, make the used to visibly realize their business logical framework and integrate the Web Service Component. With the growing number of Web Service-components, it is necessary to compose existing Web Service-components dynamically according to service request. Dynamic composition service method is proposed based on service-component, according to user demand real-time change, convenient user programming.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of the Tank Firepower Performance Based on the Topsis Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The evaluation of the tank firepower performance is very important for the demonstration, research, and use of armored vehicles. The Topsis method is applied in this article to comprehensively evaluate the firepower performance of tank, and this method is the effective evaluation method by using the multi-objective decision method to approach the ideal solution, which could effectively solve the difficulty that traditional evaluation methods are hard to integrate multiple evaluation parameters as single-efficiency measurement value, and provide a new approach to comprehensively evaluate the firepower evaluation of tank.

articleTitle: A Method to Segment the Marked Regions in Document Images
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: It's very popular to mark the concerned regions on a document using a mark pen. How to detect the marked regions in the scanned document images is a difficult problem. In this paper, an approach to solve the above problem is proposed. First, the color pixels and run-length are detected. And then, the mark-lines of document can be attained by using run-length. Finally, the mark-lines to get the marked regions are analyzed. Experimental results show the proposed method has high accuracy. Furthermore, it can be applied to many practical problems.

articleTitle: A Novel Grid Service Discovery Algorithm Based on Service Behavior Semantic Annotation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The rise in recent years, the grid is a resource-sharing technology, but in their current state of development and implementation has not been as successful as hoped in engendering distributed environment. One of important reasons which reduce the utilization of grid resources is that the resources services discoveries are not effective. This paper proposes a novel grid service discovery algorithm based on service behavior semantic annotation. This algorithm adds some semantic annotations on the service behavior. Through these processes, the efficiency of the algorithm has improved.

articleTitle: Low Cost Method for FOG Eigenfrequency Measurement
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A low-cost approach was advanced to solve the problem of measuring fiber optic gyroscope (FOG) eigen frequency. Based on the principles of square wave modulation and demodulation in digital closed-loop FOG, the modulation of phase modulator had been done using fourfold eigen frequency square wave. Analysis of the demodulated signal obtained the relation between photoelectric detector output wave pattern and the frequency of modulation square wave, so the problem of eigen frequency measuring was transformed into the problem of pulse measuring and the complex programming software and expensive measuring devices was avoided. Experimental results show that the accuracy could be up to 0.075KHz when FOG eigen frequency was measured manually using this method.

articleTitle: Entity Communication Action Control in the Organized Simulation of Electronic Countermeasure
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: According to the developments of simulation technology, it indicates that the simulation platform based on the organized information construction is the effective way of developing space electronic countermeasure system demonstration and efficiency evaluation in the future. It presents a 4-tier organized simulation communication model, and constructs action ontology (CAO), which can well solve the control problem of communication action based on the underlying high level architecture (HLA) simulation and Agent model.

articleTitle: High Accuracy Attitude Estimation and Control for Spacecraft under Strong Atmosphere Perturbations
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper investigates the high accuracy attitude estimation and control problem for spacecraft under strong atmosphere perturbation. Firstly, the atmosphere perturbations are analyzed and the attitude dynamic and kinematic equations are introduced. Then, three-axis fiber gyro and star sensor are adopted and the extended Kalman filter (EKF) are used for high accuracy attitude estimation. The reaction wheels are adopted and the magnetic torque rods are used for magnetic unloading, the feedback control law is put forward based on the feedback linearization method. Finally, numerical simulations are carried out and the results show that the proposed methods are effective and feasible, which can realize the high accuracy attitude estimation and control for spacecraft.

articleTitle: Automatic Landing Control of UAV Based on Optical Guidance
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the problem of landing for a UAV on the runway is discussed and a control method based on optical guidance is proposed. This method uses optical guidance to generate the guidance signal and then control the landing of the UAV along an ideal trajectory. In this paper, the design method of ideal trajectory and corresponding landing control method, which based on the small disturbance linearization model, are presented. The simulation results demonstrate that the control performance can satisfy the requirements of automatic landing of UAV and have the exact output tracking ability.

articleTitle: Segmentation-based Image Authentication and Recovery Scheme Using Reference Sharing Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose an efficient watermarking scheme for digital image tamper detection and recovery. To enhance the capability of resisting VQ attacks, the image is partitioned into interrelated regions with irregular shapes. Authentication watermark, which can detect and locate the tampered region, is generated by a feedback-based chaotic system. Recovery watermark is constructed by applying a reference sharing mechanism on the encoded DCT coefficients and embedded into each region dispersedly. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed scheme can successfully identify and recover the tampered regions.

articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization Model of Cognitive Wireless Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Recently, much attention has been devoted to cognitive radio network (CRN) and consequently, it renews the interest in improving the performance of wireless mesh networks (WMNs). It has been proven that cognitive radio technology combined with multi-radio multi-channel technology is a promising way for wireless network performance improvement. At the same time, they also lead to some new challenges for network architecture design and protocol optimization. This paper presents a multi-radio cognitive wireless mesh network architecture-CRMesh, which integrates the cognitive radio (CR) technology with existing wireless mesh network technologies seamlessly. A 3G Model is proposed, which can describe CRN exactly from the perspective of packet forwarding. The optimization issue of higher layer network control protocols is explored on the viewpoint of resource allocation. A novel resource allocation scheme and corresponding cross-layer optimization framework are proposed. This paper presents an overall scheme of cognitive wireless mesh network architecture design and protocol optimization.

articleTitle: Study on Ability Evaluation System of a Technical Supply Element Based on Entropy-Weight Combination Method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the equipment technical supply goal and the prime task, an evaluation index system for the technical supply element and a model based on combinatorial entropy-weight method is established in this paper. By defining the entropy weight of each index, and combining this weigh with the subjective weight evaluated by experts' experiences, the evaluation result will get more scientific and reasonable.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Secure Multi-Party Computation in Several Computational Geometry Problems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Privacy-preserving computational geometry problem is a special branch of secure multi-party computation field. It enables a group of mutually untrusted parties to jointly perform a computation geometric problem with their private input information. In this paper, we propose a private determination protocol of position relation between line and circle, and also present a private determination protocol of position relation between line and hyperbola. These protocols have potential applications in engineering, military and many other fields.

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Image Match Propagation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Stereo matching is an important part of 3D reconstruction. This paper proposes an improved match propagation algorithm. Firstly, the feature points are extracted and matched by SIFT algorithm then they are used as seed points for the image match propagation in neighborhood. Secondly, these dense correspondences are re-sampled to quasi-dense correspondences. Finally, the mismatched points and outliers are eliminated by epipolar constraint. Experiments show that this improved algorithm can be applied in the similar structure of images with great change of depth.

articleTitle: Robust sliding mode observer fault diagnosis and its application to nonlinear systems
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Robust state estimation and fault diagnosis are challenging problems in the research into nonlinear systems. In this paper a sliding mode observer is proposed for a class of nonlinear systems with unknown inputs and faults. Model uncertainties, disturbances and faults are represented as structured unknown inputs. We analyzed the robustness of sliding model control system and put forward a fault diagnosis method using sliding mode observer for fault diagnosis of uncertain control system. Robustness to model uncertainties and disturbances can be guaranteed for the sliding mode observer by disturbance decoupling. The method can supply a stable estimation of the state response of uncertain control system under normal disturbance, and furthermore realize the diagnosis for fault disturbance. The results proved the feasibility of the method.

articleTitle: An Overview of Video Object Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: With a rapid demand for multimedia information, visual information plays an important part in information achieving. But the data size of a video is so enormous that it should be compressed and coded immediately. In order to improve the efficiency of MPEG-4 and MPEG-7 adopt content-based coding method, a video sequence is segmented into several meaningful video objects before coding. Video object segmentation plays a critical role in realizing content-based coding and description, which has an immediate influence on coding efficiency and description validity. Furthermore, the video object segmentation technique is also widely used in our real life, such as video monitoring, video conference and some other areas. So many segmentation algorithms have been proposed, but the development of video object segmentation is still in its primary stage. Some of the disadvantages should be improved in the future.

articleTitle: A Method for Distributed Multi-Robot Simultaneous Localization and Mapping
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: A novel method was presented to realize the distributed multi-robot simultaneous localization and mapping for the efficient exploration of unknown environments and partial map merging. According to the robot's explored information, a single robot built its partial map and estimated its location in the next step, it could actively communicate with other robots. The communication robots formed a dynamic exploration cluster. A method of correlation matching of two right angles with less calculation was given to address the partial map merging of the robots in a cluster. The robots in a cluster share the merged map to coordinate their exploration actions and estimate their relative locations. The method enabled teams of robots to efficiently build highly accurate maps of unknown environments, even when the initial locations of the robots were unknown. Simulation results showed that the map generated by our approach was same with the standard map, and verify the high accuracy and robustness of this method.

articleTitle: The Influence of Data Process on Forming Precision of SLA Rapid Prototyping
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Rapid prototyping is an advanced technology, from which the prototypes are built quickly with photopolymers or other materials. The RP manufacture system uses lasers or ultraviolet light to expose surface of liquid resin and builds a three-dimensional part according CAD model in a layer-by-layer way. In spite of the great potentiality, some structural weakness that affect the forming precision of the parts, such as lower strength, larger shrinkage and distortion, have hindered the wide industrial application. Therefore, this study focuses on some technology parameters of the prototypes, such as data process and layer thickness. The paper summaries the influence of data process on forming precision for rapid prototyping. Finally, the significant performance of rapid prototyping for modern industry is discussed. The investigation is beneficial for choosing an optimal parameter in industry.

articleTitle: The Applications and Summary of Panoramic Modeling
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Full view panorama of a 3D scene has become popular in building virtual reality system, and also has other applications in visualization. Which has view of the characteristics of convenience by the increasingly widespread concern for the real world to provide full 360 degree scene information, which has been widely applied in various fields. The paper is focused on the research, applications and summary of panoramic modeling, it gives an analysis of panoramic imaging technology and image projection, and then introduces the panoramic image acquisition, then analysis panoramic three-dimensional modeling last gives the conclusions.

articleTitle: Research on Robust H8 Fault-Tolerant Control for Uncertain Suspension System with Time Delay
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The problem of robust H¡Þ fault-tolerant control for uncertain suspension system with time delay was investigated. Based on state feedback and Lyapunov stability theory, a sufficient condition of the existence of robust H¡Þ fault-tolerant controller was derived and then transformed to the corresponding linear matrix inequality. During inferential reasoning, the less conservative arithmetic dealing with inequality amplification was employed so that it was possible to sufficiently reduce conservative of controller design. The resultant controller enabled uncertain system with time delay to retain robust stability and disturbance attenuation as well as to tolerate actuator failure.

articleTitle: Design and Implement of University Laboratory Equipment Network Management Platform Based on C/S and B/S Model
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Lacking management of laboratory equipment in university currently, a strategy was proposed to manage laboratory equipment with network method by using software architecture based on C/S and B/S model. Network management platform for experimental equipment is a management system, which is also a complex monitoring system. For different users, being designed by reasonable software architecture, it will make better prospects for the system. This paper presents a framework of laboratory equipment management system of hybrid system, which includes the realization of main function, architecture, database design and implementation.

Author Keywords: Mixed structure of C/S and B/S model

articleTitle: PV Power Grid Technology Research
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The PV inverter model and its control strategy are researched, and then analyzes the various characteristics of interconnection and integration, establishing a selection criteria for dynamic reactive power compensation equipment's capacity and form, the output characteristics and selection of operational mode is discussed, the LVRT of PV power plant under unusual conditions is researched, based on which the PV power plant's LVRT capability enhancement of dynamic reactive power compensation equipment is researched. Through simulation, Huadian Jiayuguan 10MWp PV power project meet the integration conditions, theory and simulation is accurate, this accumulate some experience for our future development of PV power plant.

articleTitle: An RF Circuit for Overhauser Magnetometer Excitation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Overhauser magnetometer is a device for magetostatic field measurement, RF excitation is necessary for nitrogen oxygen free radical solution. In this paper, design methods coupled with simulations of a RF circuits used in Overhauser magnetometer are presented. Functionally, a RF circuit consists of three parts, namely RF signal source, RF power amplifier and the load. Generation of a 70MHz RF signal will be described. Power amplification aimed to acquire the gain of 13-16dB will be presented. Finally we get a continuous sine wave of 70MHz, 4-5W. We have validated that a linear polarization magnetic field is successfully generated inside the birdcage coil which meets the requirements of the Overhauser magnetometer. In this paper a number of conclusions are based on RF circuit simulation software ADS.

articleTitle: UAV Image Compression System Based on M-JPEG2000
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: According to the transmission characteristics of the UAV data link system, this paper introduces a minimum digital image compression and decompression system. Its core design is based on FPGA and ADV212. Comparing to previous kinds of DSP and ADV202, the system has such advantages: small size, light weight, low consumption and low compression and decompression delay. The UAV flight test results shows that this system has a high stability and can meets the requirements of UAV data transmission communication system.

articleTitle: A Time-constrained Watermarking Technique on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: The digital integrated circuits are becoming more and more complicated, the concept of design reuse has been widely accepted by the designers. However, the design reuse also makes rival competitor easier to infringe the intellectual properties (IPs). IP protection becomes a crucial work of IP reuse design style. This paper proposes a method for IP protection based on modification of time constraints. We select non-critical nets as watermark carrier and embed a watermark by modifying time constraints. Thus the FPGA configuration bit stream for the resulting watermarked design will be significantly different from the original design, which provides a strong proof of authorship. The watermarking technique has zero area overhead and low timing overhead, also effectively increases the embedding capacity of watermark simultaneously. We evaluated the method on ISCAS'89 benchmark. Compared to reference [4], our technique improved the watermarking performance.

articleTitle: A Model Based Testing Approach for Mobile Device
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Lots of research work has been done to achieve automated Graphical User Interface (GUI) testing. Model-based testing as the most popular way supports automated test case generation and execution. But building such a model usually costs lots of resource in the entire testing process. And the methods of automated model deriving are closely related to the programming language or specific OS. In this paper, we proposed a new approach of software GUI modeling for mobile device using Optical Character Recognition (OCR), which is responsible for image processing to extract character information. Case study shows that our approach is capable of analyzing most of the GUI windows, and generating the corresponding model with less work and less constraint.

articleTitle: Virtual View Rendering Based on Self-adaptive Block Matching Disparity Estimation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Virtual view rendering is one of the key techniques of interactive 3D video systems, and is analogue expression to the real world in virtual reality systems. This paper proposes a new algorithm of virtual view rendering between two views taken in the same scene at the same time, which is based on self-adaptive block matching disparity estimation. This algorithm outputs any view between the two origin views. In order to gain accurate dense disparity field, a method of self-adaptive block matching is proposed in disparity estimation according to the information of texture and gray scale. Image interpolation is used to render certain virtual view and reverse mapping is adopted to fill up holes formed in interpolation. Satisfying visual effect is shown in experimental result.

articleTitle: A Chopper Stabilized Pre-amplifier for Magnetic Sensor
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper introduced chopping principle and presented a design of chopper stabilized pre-amplifier for magnetic sensor. Compared with auto-zeroing technique, chopping technique does not fold noise to DC and the noise performance is better. This chopper stabilized pre-amplifier used the integrated instrumentation amplifier AD620 as the main amplifier. It achieved low voltage noise about 10nV/√Hz, and the corner frequency of 1/f noise about 1.5mHz. Residual offset caused by nonidealities of CMOS switch was reduced by a delayed demodulate clock. And the measured result was found to agree well with the simulated result.

articleTitle: A Cross Language Text Categorization Algorithm from the Perspective of Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we propose a novel method that performs Cross Language Text Categorization (CLTC) from the perspective of Information Retrieval. We present an input document in target language in the form of a query in source language. Then we retrieve the training documents in source language and find K most relevant results. At last, we use the class labels of the K results to predict the class of the input document. The only external resource required by our method is a bilingual dictionary. Experimental results show that our method gives promising performance, which is better than translation-based method.

articleTitle: An Innovative Method of Endmember Extraction of Hyperspectral Remote Sensing Image Using Elitist Ant System (EAS)
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Spectrum unmixing is an important content of Hyperspectral Remote Sensing (HRS) image processing, and end member extraction is a key step of spectrum unmixing. Most of the available end member extraction algorithms are based on linear spectral mixture model, and algorithms' accuracy is closely related to data's quality. According to linear spectral mixture model, this paper redefined end member extraction as a combinatorial optimization problem (COP), then introduced Elitist Ant System (EAS), a classical type of Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), to solve COP. The experiments revealed that a better end member extraction result could be obtained from HRS data of the same quality by using EAS than N-finder and VCA.

articleTitle: Cooperative Spectrum Sensing for Cognitive Radio Networks under Nakagami-M Fading Channels
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper shows decision fusion rules for Cognitive Radio (CR) Networks under Nakagami-m fading channels. Due to detection performance limitation of the secondary users based mixed fusion rule, a new Likelihood Radio Test (LRT) fusion rule was proposed. Theoretical analysis and simulations show that the new fusion rule has better detection than conventional fusion rules.

articleTitle: Design Patterns Applied in Power System Analysis Software Package
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: Power System Analysis Software Package (PSASP) is widely used in power system simulation. The design of PSASP faces many changeable factors. Several design patterns in object-oriented programming are applied in the design of PSASP to reduce the difficulty and complexity of PSASP software design. It is proved that applying design patterns in the design of PSASP can simplify the structure of software, improve the reusability of code and effectively face the challenge of changing. In this article, the application of MVC, composite, bridge, decorator, command, and abstract factory design patterns are presented and described in detail.

articleTitle: Cross-term Reduction Using Wigner Hough Transform and Back Estimation
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Industrial Control and Electronics Engineering
abstract: This paper presents some algorithms to reduce the cross-terms, which are unfortunate mathematical artifacts in the calculation of Wigner Ville Distribution (WVD) of a multi-component signal. The experiments are carried out for linear FM signals which have a line representation in the spectral domain. When the WVD of a multi-component signal is calculated, sometimes the cross-terms will show higher peaks compared to the main signal components. There have been many methods proposed to filter out these cross terms, so that the signal can be precisely represented in the time-frequency domain. In this paper, a method based on Hough Transform is used for the same purpose. A line in the time-frequency domain can be represented as a point in the Hough transformed domain. Once we identify the coordinates of this point in the transformed domain, we can estimate the properties of the line in the time-frequency domain which corresponds exactly to the actual signal components. This paper proposes a new idea of back estimation to filter out only the components corresponding to cross-terms from the time-frequency domain of WVD. This paper also briefs about the implementation of the algorithms in Matlab for different values of signal to noise ratios.

articleTitle: Face Detection Based on Skin Color Model and Geometry Features
